66338.recognize_zh: 中央白血球細胞質邊緣有數顆粗大的黑褐色瘧色素（hemozoin）顆粒；背景紅血球大量感染細小環狀體、多重感染與 appliqué 型，並有少數深染長形寄生蟲體，符合重度惡性瘧（P. falciparum）伴隨吞噬瘧色素的白血球。
features: Central leukocyte with a band-like to minimally segmented nucleus and pink granular cytoplasm containing a cluster of coarse black-brown hemozoin granules
Numerous red cells with small delicate ring forms, many multiply infected, with appliqué forms
Scattered compact dark-staining elongated parasite forms, some pigmented, suggestive of maturing stages or gametocytes
Infected red cells normal in size without Schüffner stippling
Mild red cell overlap in thick areas limits assessment of some forms
66338.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows high-grade parasitemia with numerous small ring forms, frequent multiply infected red cells and appliqué forms in normal-sized erythrocytes. Scattered compact, darkly staining elongated parasites, some containing pigment, are also present. A central neutrophil contains coarse black-brown intracytoplasmic granules consistent with phagocytosed malarial pigment (hemozoin). Findings are consistent with severe Plasmodium falciparum malaria with pigment-laden neutrophils.

ddx.vs: Babesia rings are pleomorphic with tetrads and produce no hemozoin, so pigment in leukocytes excludes it.
P. malariae shows band-form trophozoites and rosette schizonts with low parasitemia, not heavy multiple ring infection.

ddx.dx: Coarse toxic granulation or Alder-Reilly granules
ddx.vs: Toxic and Alder-Reilly granules are purple-violet and uniformly distributed rather than refractile black-brown clumps.
Precipitate lies on top of cells and in the background, whereas hemozoin is confined within cytoplasm in the same focal plane.

exam.answer_en: Severe P. falciparum malaria — heavy ring-form parasitemia with multiply infected cells and a hemozoin-containing neutrophil
pearls_zh: 考法：要你估算 parasitemia 並指出 pigment-laden neutrophil；parasitemia = 受感染紅血球 / 總紅血球，多重感染的紅血球只算一顆。
Thick smear 用來偵測（敏感），thin smear 用來鑑定物種與計算寄生蟲比例；抗原快篩（HRP2）不能取代抹片定量。
周邊血出現 mature trophozoite 或 schizont 在 falciparum 感染中較少見，若大量出現提示寄生蟲負荷高、病情較重。
旅遊史是關鍵：台灣本土已無瘧疾，病例多為境外移入，發燒返國者需主動詢問疫區旅遊。
exam.pitfall_zh: 重疊在紅血球上的血小板易被誤認為環狀體；真正環狀體有藍色細胞質環與紅紫色染色點、位於紅血球平面內，血小板則無環狀結構且常突出邊緣。

quiz.q: 計算圖中 parasitemia 時，一顆紅血球內有三個環狀體應計為幾顆受感染紅血球？

65954.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的是一顆較大、略帶藍灰色（多染性）的紅血球，胞質內有一顆單一、圓形、深紫色的小點，位置偏邊緣，這就是豪威爾-喬利小體（Howell-Jolly body）。
features: Single round, dense, dark purple inclusion (~1 μm) near the periphery of a red cell
Host cell is larger than neighbors with faint bluish-gray tint (polychromasia) and reduced central pallor
Surrounding red cells show anisopoikilocytosis with several oval forms/macro-ovalocytes and scattered teardrop and fragmented shapes
Scattered small platelets in background; no leukocytes in field
65954.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows anisopoikilocytosis with scattered oval and irregular red cells. A large polychromatic red cell (arrow) contains a single, round, dense, deeply basophilic inclusion located eccentrically, consistent with a Howell-Jolly body (nuclear remnant). No basophilic stippling or parasites are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with a Howell-Jolly body; in the setting of macrocytic anemia this reflects dyserythropoiesis (e.g., megaloblastic anemia), while numerous Howell-Jolly bodies would raise hyposplenism.

ddx.vs: Pappenheimer bodies are multiple, small, irregular granules clustered at the cell edge and stain with Prussian blue, whereas a Howell-Jolly body is usually single, larger, round and iron-negative.
An overlying platelet is larger, has a pale halo and granular texture and often lies in a different focal plane, unlike the smooth dense uniform Howell-Jolly body.
A Plasmodium ring shows a blue cytoplasmic ring with a red chromatin dot, not a solid dark homogeneous dot.
Basophilic stippling consists of numerous fine or coarse dots dispersed throughout the cell rather than one discrete round body.

exam.answer_en: Howell-Jolly body — single round dense dark purple nuclear remnant in a polychromatic red cell
pearls_zh: 考法：指紅血球內單一深紫圓點問名稱；答 Howell-Jolly body（DNA 核殘留），Feulgen 陽性、鐵染色陰性。
多顆 Howell-Jolly bodies 最常代表脾切除或功能性脾臟低下（sickle cell、celiac disease）。
脾臟低下病人對莢膜菌（S. pneumoniae、H. influenzae、N. meningitidis）感染風險高，需疫苗接種。
伴巨紅血球（macro-ovalocyte）時，Howell-Jolly body 反映 dyserythropoiesis，如 megaloblastic anemia。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與重疊的血小板或 Pappenheimer bodies 混淆；血小板較大有淡色暈與顆粒，Pappenheimer 為多顆小而不規則的邊緣顆粒且鐵染色陽性。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指紅血球內的圓點是什麼？大量出現時最常提示什麼臨床狀況？
quiz.a: Howell-Jolly body；脾切除或脾功能低下（asplenia/hyposplenism）。

66210.recognize_zh: D 與 I 圖可見中等大小、胞質透亮的非典型淋巴球，混在發炎細胞與分支狀高內皮小靜脈（HEV）之間；E/F/J/K 圖 PD-1 與 ICOS 陽性表示 T 濾泡輔助（TFH）表型，L 圖 TCRγ PCR 呈單株峰，符合血管免疫母細胞型 TFH 淋巴瘤。
features: Gross (A-B): well-circumscribed yellow-tan transmural colonic mass with homogeneous fleshy cut surface
Low power (C, G-H): dense diffuse lymphoid infiltrate with residual follicles; nodal lesion outlined with dashed line
Medium-sized atypical lymphocytes with clear cytoplasm and round-to-irregular nuclei in a mixed inflammatory background
Prominent arborizing high endothelial venules with pink perivascular stroma (D, I)
IHC: clusters of PD-1-positive and ICOS-positive atypical cells in colon (E-F) and lymph node (J-K)
TCR gamma PCR (L): dominant discrete peaks indicating clonal rearrangement
66210.describe_en: Composite figure. The resected colon contains a well-circumscribed, yellow-tan, fleshy transmural mass (A-B). Sections show a dense lymphoid infiltrate with scattered residual follicles (C); at high power, medium-sized atypical lymphocytes with clear cytoplasm and irregular nuclei are admixed with small lymphocytes, plasma cells and histiocytes around prominent arborizing high endothelial venules (D). The atypical cells express PD-1 and ICOS (E-F). A regional lymph node shows a similar partially effacing infiltrate (G-I) with PD-1 and ICOS positivity (J-K), and PCR demonstrates a clonal TCR gamma gene rearrangement (L). Findings are consistent with T-follicular helper cell lymphoma, angioimmunoblastic type, arising primarily in the colon with secondary nodal involvement.

ddx.vs: PTCL-NOS lacks expression of at least two TFH markers (PD-1, ICOS, BCL6, CXCL13, CD10) and usually lacks the clear-cell, HEV-rich angioimmunoblastic background.
MEITL shows monotonous CD8+/CD56+ cells with marked epitheliotropism, whereas these cells are CD4+/CD8- with TFH markers and an inflammatory, vascular-rich background.

ddx.dx: Reactive follicular hyperplasia / colitis with TFH cells
ddx.vs: Reactive PD-1+ TFH cells stay within germinal centers without clear-cell interfollicular expansion and lack clonal TCR rearrangement.
ATLL can express TFH-like markers but shows pleomorphic flower cells, CD25 positivity and HTLV-1 seropositivity, which was negative here.

66210.stain: Gross; H&E; IHC: PD-1, ICOS; PCR

65762.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片與切片被胞質稀少、染色質細緻的母細胞樣細胞大片取代，形態看似急性白血病；但 CD138 膜狀瀰漫陽性、p53 強陽性、EBER 陰性，流式為 CD38/CD138 亮陽性且 kappa 單株，加上骨髓瘤病史，符合母細胞樣漿細胞白血病。
features: Aspirate: sheets of medium-sized blastoid cells with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm, some eccentric nuclei
Blood: circulating blastoid cells with round nuclei and a thin rim of blue cytoplasm
Core biopsy: diffuse sheets of monotonous cells with vesicular nuclei and small nucleoli (inset)
CD138: diffuse membranous positivity; p53: strong nuclear staining in nearly all cells; EBER ISH negative
Flow: CD45-dim/low-SSC population (red) that is CD19+, CD20+, partial CD10, surface kappa+, CD38 and CD138 bright, CD34-negative
65762.describe_en: Peripheral blood contains circulating blastoid cells, and the bone marrow aspirate is replaced by sheets of medium-sized cells with fine chromatin, high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio and basophilic cytoplasm, without obvious plasmacytoid features. The core biopsy shows diffuse sheets of monotonous cells that are diffusely CD138-positive with strong p53 overexpression and negative EBER in situ hybridization. Flow cytometry identifies a dominant CD45-dim population with bright CD38 and CD138, surface kappa restriction and aberrant CD19/CD20 with partial CD10, lacking CD34 and TdT. In the context of known myeloma, findings are consistent with secondary plasma cell leukemia with blastoid morphology.

ddx.vs: PBL is usually EBER-positive, arises in immunodeficiency or extranodal sites without a myeloma history, and is CD20-negative.
B-ALL blasts are TdT- and/or CD34-positive and lack bright CD38/CD138 and surface light-chain restriction.
Blastoid MCL also carries IGH::CCND1 but is CD5+, SOX11+ and CD138-negative with dim rather than bright CD38.
AML blasts express CD34/CD117/MPO and myeloid antigens, all negative here.

65762.stain: Wright-Giemsa; H&E; IHC: CD138, p53; EBER; flow

65634.recognize_zh: 拼圖中多顆嗜中性球的核葉以放射狀圍繞中心點排列、彼此由細絲相連，形似葡萄串或花朵（botryoid neutrophils）；在古柯鹼使用或熱傷害、中暑等情境中可見。
features: Mature neutrophils of normal size with fine pink-lilac cytoplasmic granules
Nuclear lobes (4-6) arranged radially around a central point, producing a grape-cluster or flower-like configuration
Lobes connected by thin chromatin filaments converging centrally
Condensed mature chromatin; no toxic vacuolation or Döhle bodies evident
Background normochromic red cells
65634.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (composite of multiple neutrophils) shows mature neutrophils with normal cytoplasmic granulation whose nuclear lobes are arranged radially around a central point and joined by thin filaments, producing a botryoid (grape-cluster or flower-like) configuration. Chromatin is mature and there is no significant toxic change in these cells. Botryoid nuclei are a nonspecific finding associated with hyperthermia, heat stroke, burns and recreational drug use such as cocaine. Findings are consistent with botryoid neutrophils.

ddx.vs: Hypersegmented neutrophils have 6 or more lobes arranged linearly along a chromatin strand rather than radially around a central hub, with macro-ovalocytes.

ddx.dx: Clover-leaf / flower cells of HTLV-1 adult T-cell leukemia
ddx.vs: Flower cells are lymphocytes with agranular basophilic cytoplasm and petal-like lobulated nuclei, not granulated neutrophils.
Neutrophils show pyknotic, hypercondensed lobes separated by long thin filaments, with profound neutropenia.

65570.recognize_zh: 觸片中的芽細胞細胞質深藍並伴許多空泡，切片呈成片不成熟細胞與網狀纖維增生；CD117 與 CD71 陽性、p53 強陽性且 MPO 陰性，指向具紅系分化的 TP53 突變 AML（純紅系白血病型態）。
features: Touch imprint with blasts showing deeply basophilic cytoplasm and numerous clear vacuoles (panel A)
Biopsy with sheets of large immature mononuclear cells with vesicular nuclei and nucleoli (panel B)
Increased reticulin fibers forming a dense network (panel C)
Blasts partially CD117 positive (panel D) and CD71 positive (panel E), supporting erythroid differentiation
Strong diffuse nuclear p53 overexpression (panel F)
65570.describe_en: Bone marrow touch imprint shows numerous blasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and prominent cytoplasmic vacuolation. The core biopsy shows sheets of large immature mononuclear cells with vesicular chromatin and nucleoli, and the reticulin stain demonstrates markedly increased reticulin fibrosis. By immunohistochemistry the immature cells express CD117 and CD71 with strong, diffuse nuclear p53 overexpression, and are MPO negative. Findings are consistent with an acute myeloid leukemia with erythroid differentiation and TP53 alteration, classified as acute erythroid leukemia (WHO 5th) or AML with mutated TP53 (ICC).

ddx.vs: Megakaryoblasts also cause fibrosis and have basophilic blebbed cytoplasm but are CD41/CD61 positive and CD71/E-cadherin negative.
Megaloblastic change shows orderly maturation with open sieve-like chromatin in maturing forms, no p53 overexpression, and B12/folate deficiency.

ddx.dx: Burkitt lymphoma or other vacuolated blasts
ddx.vs: Burkitt cells are CD19/CD20/CD10 positive B cells and lack CD71/E-cadherin erythroid markers.
Non-hematopoietic tumors are keratin, synaptophysin, or desmin positive and lack CD117/CD71/E-cadherin erythroid expression.

65570.stain: Giemsa; H&E; reticulin; IHC: CD117, CD71, p53

65506.recognize_zh: PAS 染色下，淋巴結組織中滿佈大小不一（約 5–15 µm）的圓形到卵圓形、洋紅色酵母菌體，有些可見窄基底出芽（narrow-based budding），呈淚滴狀。菌體大小不均加上窄基出芽，是 Cryptococcus 的線索。
features: Innumerable round to oval PAS-positive magenta yeast forms
Marked variation in yeast size, roughly 5–15 µm
Narrow-based budding with teardrop-shaped daughter cells
Some yeasts show a thick refractile wall with a paler surrounding halo
Yeasts lie within a delicate PAS-positive reticular stroma with little inflammatory reaction
65506.describe_en: Lymph node biopsy stained with PAS shows effacement by innumerable round to oval PAS-positive yeast forms embedded in a delicate fibrillary stroma. The organisms vary considerably in size and several show narrow-based, teardrop-shaped budding; no hyphae or pseudohyphae are seen. Granulomatous response is inconspicuous in this field. Findings are consistent with cryptococcal lymphadenitis; confirmation with mucicarmine capsule staining or cryptococcal antigen testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts are small (2–4 µm), uniform and intracellular within histiocytes, without a mucicarmine-positive capsule.
Blastomyces yeasts are 8–15 µm with a thick double-contoured wall and broad-based budding, not narrow-based teardrop budding.
Candida shows small budding yeasts together with pseudohyphae, which are absent here.
Pneumocystis cysts are uniform cup-shaped forms in foamy alveolar exudate, better seen on GMS, and do not bud.

exam.answer_en: Cryptococcal lymphadenitis (PAS) — numerous PAS-positive yeasts of variable size with narrow-based budding
pearls_zh: 考法：PAS 染出大小不一酵母，考官問病原與下一步染色；答 Cryptococcus，mucicarmine 染莢膜確認。
PAS 與 GMS 只染菌體壁，無法區分真菌種類；Cryptococcus 特徵為大小不一與 narrow-based budding。
莢膜缺乏株 mucicarmine 可能弱陽性，可用 Fontana-Masson（melanin）陽性輔助。
臨床：常見於 HIV（CD4 低）或免疫抑制病人，淋巴結侵犯代表播散性感染，需做 CSF 檢查與 serum cryptococcal antigen。
治療：amphotericin B + flucytosine 誘導，之後 fluconazole 鞏固與維持。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 Histoplasma 混淆：Histoplasma 小（2–4 µm）且大小一致、多在巨噬細胞內；Blastomyces 為厚壁、broad-based budding。

quiz.q: PAS 染色下這些大小不一、窄基出芽的酵母最可能為何？下一步用哪種特殊染色確認？
quiz.a: Cryptococcus；mucicarmine（染莢膜）。

65378.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中可見一個圓形囊泡（vesicle），四周放射狀排列密集的瓶梗（phialide），外緣有棕色分生孢子（conidia），這種完整的分生孢子頭（fruiting head）是麴菌（Aspergillus）的特徵。
features: Round conidial head composed of a central swollen vesicle with densely packed radiating phialides
Brown-pigmented, round conidia at the periphery and scattered nearby
Fruiting head lies in a cleared space separate from the marrow tissue
Adjacent hematopoietic marrow with fat cells and mixed trilineage cells
No tissue-invasive septate hyphae or inflammatory reaction visible in this field
65378.describe_en: H&E-stained bone marrow section shows a conidial head consisting of a round vesicle with densely radiating phialides and brown-pigmented peripheral conidia, lying in a cleared space adjacent to hematopoietic marrow with fat. Tissue-invasive hyphae, necrosis and inflammatory response are not seen in this field. The structure is diagnostic of Aspergillus species, and pigmented conidia suggest a dematiaceous-conidia species such as A. niger. Because conidiophore formation requires an air interface and is rare within deep tissue, correlation with invasive hyphae elsewhere, culture and exclusion of laboratory contamination are recommended.

ddx.vs: A fruiting head floating outside tissue without invasive hyphae or host reaction raises contamination, which is excluded by finding hyphae within tissue and by culture.
Mucorales form broad, ribbon-like pauciseptate hyphae with right-angle branching and sporangia rather than phialide-bearing vesicles.
These produce acute-angle septate hyphae similar to Aspergillus but not radiating conidial heads, so culture or molecular identification is needed.

65314.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片高倍下可見多顆大型組織球，細胞質豐富、淡粉紅色並呈纖維狀、類似皺摺紙張（wrinkled tissue paper）的紋理，核小而偏心，背景為增生的顆粒球系細胞，符合 CML 中的假性高雪氏細胞（pseudo-Gaucher cells）。
features: Large histiocytes with abundant eosinophilic, fibrillary to striated cytoplasm resembling wrinkled tissue paper
Small, round to oval, eccentric nuclei with vesicular chromatin
Histiocytes occur singly and in small clusters
Background of densely packed granulocytic precursors and segmented forms
Scattered larger cells with hyperchromatic nuclei, possibly small megakaryocytes
65314.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy at high magnification shows a hypercellular marrow with granulocytic predominance. Scattered singly and in small clusters are large histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic, fibrillary cytoplasm resembling wrinkled tissue paper and small eccentric nuclei. In a patient with BCR::ABL1-positive myeloid neoplasm, findings are consistent with pseudo-Gaucher cells secondary to increased cell turnover in chronic myeloid leukemia.

ddx.vs: True Gaucher cells are morphologically identical and are separated by reduced glucocerebrosidase activity or GBA mutation rather than a background myeloproliferative neoplasm.

ddx.dx: Mycobacterial spindle-cell pseudotumor or Mycobacterium avium complex
ddx.vs: MAC-laden histiocytes can appear striated but are acid-fast positive, typically with granulomas in immunosuppressed patients.
Crystal-storing histiocytes contain immunoglobulin crystals with light-chain restriction in a lymphoplasmacytic neoplasm rather than a granulocytic proliferation.

65186.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片與抹片中巨核細胞的核分成多個分離、深染的小葉，沿細胞周邊排成一圈環狀（ring-form），中央為細胞質；CD61 證實巨核細胞群聚與環狀型態，CD34 在部分巨核細胞異常表現，屬 MDS 的巨核細胞發育不良。
features: Hypercellular marrow with increased eosinophils and clustered megakaryocytes
Megakaryocytes with multiple widely separated, round, hyperchromatic nuclear lobes arranged in a peripheral ring around central cytoplasm (ring-form)
Aspirate: megakaryocytes with separated nuclear lobes in a background of myeloid precursors
CD34 highlights scattered blasts and shows aberrant cytoplasmic expression in megakaryocytes (inset)
CD61 highlights megakaryocyte clusters with ring-form nuclear arrangement
65186.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with increased eosinophils and clustered dysplastic megakaryocytes. Many megakaryocytes show hyperchromatic, widely separated nuclear lobes arranged in a ring around central cytoplasm, a feature also seen on the aspirate smear. CD34 immunostain shows mildly increased blasts with aberrant expression in megakaryocytes, and CD61 confirms megakaryocyte clustering and ring-form morphology. Findings are consistent with a myelodysplastic neoplasm with prominent megakaryocytic dysplasia (ring-form megakaryocytes); with 9% blasts this corresponds to MDS with increased blasts.

ddx.dx: Megakaryocytes with separated nuclear lobes after chemotherapy or in HIV
ddx.vs: Separated lobes also occur with toxic or reactive states, but these lack clustering, increased CD34+ blasts and clonal cytogenetic abnormalities.
MPN megakaryocytes are large with hyperlobated or cloud-like nuclei in dense clusters with fibrosis, rather than small discrete round lobes in a ring.
Micromegakaryocytes are small with mono- or hypolobated nuclei, whereas ring-form megakaryocytes are larger with multiple separated lobes.
Osteoclasts are multinucleated with many uniform, evenly spaced oval nuclei lying on bone surfaces and are CD61 negative.

65122.recognize_zh: 整個視野幾乎所有紅血球都呈橢圓形到長桿狀（elliptocytes、pencil cells），兩端圓鈍，部分中央仍有淡染區，只有極少數圓形紅血球；大量（通常 >25%）且均一的橢圓形紅血球是遺傳性橢圓形紅血球症的典型表現。此圖以灰階呈現，許多細胞邊緣呈鋸齒狀，屬製片皺縮假象。
features: Majority of red cells are elliptocytes and ovalocytes, ranging from egg-shaped to elongated rod- or pencil-shaped forms
Rounded ends with hemoglobin concentrated toward the poles; some cells retain central pallor
Very few round discocytes in the field
Crenated, scalloped membranes on many elliptocytes, consistent with drying artifact
No significant fragmentation, spherocytes or target cells; image displayed in grayscale so color assessment is not possible
65122.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows that the large majority of red cells are elliptocytes, ranging from ovalocytes to elongated rod- and pencil-shaped forms with rounded ends and hemoglobin concentrated at the poles. Round discocytes are infrequent. Many cells show crenated margins, attributable to smear preparation artifact, and there is no significant population of schistocytes, spherocytes or budding forms. The image is rendered in grayscale, so polychromasia and hypochromia cannot be assessed. Findings are consistent with hereditary elliptocytosis.

ddx.vs: Iron deficiency produces hypochromic microcytic pencil cells mixed with target cells and anisocytosis, usually as a minority population, not a near-uniform elliptocyte population.
Megaloblastic anemia shows large macro-ovalocytes with hypersegmented neutrophils and marked anisopoikilocytosis rather than uniform normal-sized elliptocytes.
SAO cells are rounder, rigid stomatocytic ovalocytes with one or two transverse slits or bars and a 27-bp SLC4A1 deletion.
HPP shows marked microcytosis with bizarre fragments, budding cells and microspherocytes in addition to elliptocytes.

exam.answer_en: Hereditary elliptocytosis — the majority of red cells are uniform elliptocytes and pencil-shaped forms with rounded ends
pearls_zh: 考法：指整片橢圓形紅血球問診斷；答 hereditary elliptocytosis，重點是橢圓形紅血球比例高且形狀均一，而非少量混雜。
分子機轉：膜骨架水平（horizontal）連結缺陷，多為 α-spectrin、β-spectrin 自體聯結或 protein 4.1 缺陷；多數自體顯性，常無症狀或僅輕度溶血。
嚴重型 hereditary pyropoikilocytosis 為 spectrin 雙等位缺陷，MCV 極低、大量碎片與 microspherocyte，新生兒期可嚴重溶血。
HE 的 osmotic fragility 多正常；診斷以抹片型態與家族史為主，必要時做膜蛋白或基因檢測。
exam.pitfall_zh: 常與缺鐵的 pencil cell 或 megaloblastic macro-ovalocyte 混淆；HE 為大量均一、大小正常的橢圓形紅血球，缺鐵則為少量、低色素小球性且大小不均。

quiz.q: 圖中大多數紅血球呈什麼形狀？主要牽涉哪一類紅血球膜骨架連結缺陷？
quiz.a: Elliptocytes；horizontal 連結缺陷（spectrin 自體聯結或 protein 4.1）。

65058.recognize_zh: 視野中央一顆大細胞含三個卵圓形核與大量淡藍、細空泡狀細胞質，周圍是小淋巴球與骨髓細胞；本張看不到明確被吞入的血球，因此只能說是多核大型組織球或腫瘤細胞，需搭配同病例其他圖判斷噬血現象。
features: Single very large cell (roughly 8-10 times the diameter of surrounding small cells) with three oval nuclei
Nuclei with finely reticular chromatin and no conspicuous nucleoli
Abundant pale blue, finely vacuolated cytoplasm with a smooth cell border
No unequivocally ingested nucleated cells or red cells identified within the cytoplasm in this field
Background of small lymphocytes, erythroid precursors and thick red cell aggregates
65058.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large multinucleated cell containing three oval nuclei with fine chromatin and abundant pale, finely vacuolated cytoplasm, set in a background of small mononuclear hematopoietic cells. No clearly engulfed hematopoietic elements are identified within this cell at this focal plane, so hemophagocytosis cannot be confirmed from this image alone. The cell may represent an activated multinucleated histiocyte or a metastatic tumor cell; correlation with the other fields of this case, which show hemophagocytes and metastatic adenocarcinoma, is required. Findings are suggestive of, but not diagnostic for, secondary hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells show nuclear pleomorphism, prominent nucleoli, deeply basophilic cytoplasm and cohesive clusters, whereas this cell has bland nuclei and pale cytoplasm.
Osteoclasts contain many (often >10) uniform, separate nuclei and granular reddish cytoplasm rather than three nuclei in pale vacuolated cytoplasm.
Megakaryocytes have a single multilobed connected nucleus and granular pink cytoplasm, not separate discrete nuclei.
A diagnostic hemophagocyte must contain recognizable engulfed red cells, nucleated cells or platelets, which are not clearly seen here.

64930.recognize_zh: 整片紅血球大小形狀差異極大：可見低色素細胞、標靶細胞、帶棘狀突起的棘形與皺縮紅血球、碎片，且多顆紅血球內有深紫色圓點的 Howell-Jolly 小體（提示脾切除或脾功能低下），符合重型 β 型地中海貧血的抹片。
features: Marked anisopoikilocytosis with hypochromic and microcytic red cells
Target cells and hypochromic cells with irregular central pallor
Numerous spiculated cells (acanthocytes and echinocytes) and red cell fragments
Multiple Howell-Jolly bodies (single dense purple inclusions) suggesting hyposplenism
Occasional larger bluish-gray polychromatic cells
Scattered platelets; no nucleated red cells clearly seen in this field
64930.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with a dimorphic-appearing red cell population. There are numerous hypochromic microcytes, target cells, spiculated cells (acanthocytes and echinocytes), and fragmented forms, together with polychromatic cells. Many red cells contain Howell-Jolly bodies, raising the possibility of prior splenectomy or functional hyposplenism. Findings are consistent with severe thalassemia such as beta-thalassemia major in the appropriate clinical and hemoglobin analysis context; transfused donor cells may account for the normal-appearing population.

ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps with target cells and microcytosis; hemoglobin electrophoresis or HPLC showing HbE is required for separation.
HbH disease shows similar hypochromic poikilocytes but HbH inclusions ('golf ball' cells) appear on supravital brilliant cresyl blue staining.
Iron deficiency produces pencil cells and hypochromia but lacks the extreme poikilocytosis, numerous target cells, and Howell-Jolly bodies; iron studies are low.
Howell-Jolly bodies, acanthocytes, and target cells occur after splenectomy alone, but without the marked hypochromic microcytosis of thalassemia.

exam.answer_en: Beta-thalassemia major — marked hypochromic microcytic anisopoikilocytosis with target cells and Howell-Jolly bodies (hyposplenism)
pearls_zh: 考法：問「抹片上找得到哪些異常」並推論病因；Howell-Jolly bodies 代表脾切除或功能性無脾，是 β-thal major 常見的延伸考點。
確診靠 Hb 分析（HPLC/電泳）：β0/β0 時 HbA 缺如、HbF 為主、HbA2 可升高；已輸血者 Hb 分析會被捐血者紅血球干擾，需看輸血前或做 HBB 基因檢測。
機轉：β chain 缺乏使多餘 α chain 沉積於紅血球前驅細胞，造成 ineffective erythropoiesis 與溶血。
臨床：規律輸血加 iron chelation（deferoxamine、deferasirox、deferiprone）；鐵沉積以心臟與肝臟 MRI T2* 評估，心衰竭是重要死因。
台灣產前篩檢：MCV 偏低時先排除缺鐵，再驗 HbA2；夫妻皆為帶因者需做產前診斷。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為嚴重缺鐵性貧血：缺鐵以 pencil cell 為主、少見大量 target cell 與 Howell-Jolly bodies，且 ferritin 低；Hb 分析與鐵學檢查可區分。

quiz.q: 圖中多顆紅血球內的深紫色小圓點稱為什麼？代表病人什麼狀態？
quiz.a: Howell-Jolly bodies；脾切除後或功能性無脾（hyposplenism）。

64738.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中骨小樑間的造血組織比脂肪多，細胞密度高於同齡預期，可見三系造血與多顆巨核細胞；在此低倍 H&E 下漿細胞難以單獨辨認，需搭配 CD138 染色才知道細胞增加的原因。
features: Hypercellular marrow space between bony trabeculae with reduced fat
Trilineage hematopoiesis with scattered megakaryocytes of normal appearance
Mixed population of small and medium mononuclear cells; plasma cells not individually discernible at this power
Intact trabecular bone without obvious lytic change in this field
Scattered sinusoidal hemorrhage
64738.describe_en: H&E-stained bone marrow trephine at low magnification shows marrow spaces between intact bony trabeculae that are hypercellular for age. There is trilineage hematopoiesis with adequate megakaryocytes and a mixed population of mononuclear cells, but no discrete sheets or nodules of plasma cells are identifiable at this power. The cause of the hypercellularity cannot be determined on H&E alone; CD138 immunostaining in this case revealed an interstitial plasma cell infiltrate of about 15% of cellularity. Findings are consistent with a hypercellular marrow with subtle involvement by a plasma cell neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Reactive hyperplasia shows orderly trilineage maturation without an increase in CD138-positive plasma cells or light-chain restriction.
MPN shows clustered, atypical or enlarged megakaryocytes and may have reticulin fibrosis, rather than normal megakaryocytes with an interstitial plasma cell increase.
MDS shows dysplastic megakaryocytes, abnormal localization of immature precursors and cytopenias, confirmed on aspirate morphology and cytogenetics.

64482.recognize_zh: 一顆比紅血球還小的皺縮細胞，核染色質濃縮成深藍紫色，並可見兩個小而圓的濃縮核碎片位於淡染空泡內，細胞質少且泛藍，符合凋亡淋巴球的核碎裂（karyorrhexis）。
features: Small, shrunken cell (about 7 µm), smaller than adjacent red cells
Intensely condensed, homogeneous dark nuclear chromatin
Two small round dense nuclear fragments (apoptotic bodies) within a pale vacuolated area
Scant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with an irregular outline
Background normochromic red cells, including a teardrop-like cell
64482.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a small shrunken cell with markedly condensed chromatin and two small, round, dense nuclear fragments lying within a clear vacuole, surrounded by scant basophilic cytoplasm. No nucleolus or preserved chromatin pattern is identified. In a patient treated with cladribine for hairy cell leukemia, these features represent an apoptotic lymphocyte showing cell shrinkage, pyknosis, and karyorrhexis.

ddx.vs: A late normoblast has a single round pyknotic nucleus and hemoglobinized pink cytoplasm rather than multiple nuclear fragments in blue cytoplasm.
Storage-damaged neutrophils are larger, retain neutrophilic granules, and show round detached lobes in pink cytoplasm.
Micromegakaryocytes have a dense single nucleus with granular pink cytoplasm and platelet budding, not fragmented chromatin in vacuoles.

64418.recognize_zh: 甲狀腺細針抽吸抹片中有許多核偏心、染色質呈粗塊、核旁淡染、細胞質藍色並帶少量顆粒的漿細胞，流式細胞顯示 CD38+/CD138+、cyLambda 限制且 CD19 陰性，符合骨髓瘤侵犯甲狀腺。
features: MRI (A): enhancing mass in the right thyroid lobe
Aspirate smear (B, C): numerous plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, coarse clock-face chromatin and perinuclear hof
Moderate to abundant blue cytoplasm, some cells with fine azurophilic granules; occasional large plasma cells
Scattered stripped naked nuclei with pale nucleoli and a single neutrophil in the background
Flow (D): CD45+ CD38 bright CD138+ plasma cells with cytoplasmic lambda restriction and CD19 negativity
64418.describe_en: Fine-needle aspiration smears of the right thyroid lesion show numerous plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, coarse clumped chromatin, perinuclear clearing, and moderate to abundant blue cytoplasm, some containing fine granules, admixed with stripped nuclei and rare neutrophils. No follicular epithelial groups or colloid are apparent in these fields. Flow cytometry of the aspirate demonstrates a CD45-positive, CD38-bright, CD138-positive plasma cell population with cytoplasmic lambda light chain restriction and absent CD19. Findings are consistent with thyroid involvement by a lambda-restricted plasma cell neoplasm (multiple myeloma/extramedullary plasmacytoma).

ddx.vs: Medullary carcinoma cells may look plasmacytoid but have salt-and-pepper chromatin, amyloid, calcitonin positivity, and lack CD138/light chain restriction.
Hashimoto thyroiditis contains polytypic plasma cells with lymphocytes, germinal center cells and Hürthle cells rather than a monotypic plasma cell sheet.

ddx.dx: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: MALT lymphoma shows a CD19/CD20-positive monotypic B-cell component with lymphoepithelial lesions, whereas here plasma cells are CD19-negative without a B-cell population.
HCC cells are cohesive polygonal cells with central nuclei, prominent nucleoli, and HepPar1/arginase positivity rather than dispersed eccentric-nucleus plasma cells.

64354.recognize_zh: 箭頭處細胞核碎裂成許多小圓葉、聚成一團葡萄串狀，細胞質內有多個清亮空泡，符合帶有反應性空泡的 botryoid 嗜中性球。
features: Enlarged neutrophil with nucleus broken into numerous small rounded lobes clustered centrally (botryoid pattern)
Dense, dark-staining chromatin in each lobe
Multiple clear cytoplasmic vacuoles, some adjacent to nuclear lobes
Pale cytoplasm; a possible small ingested inclusion within one vacuole, not clearly identifiable at this resolution
Bone marrow aspirate background with red cells, small lymphocytes and erythroid precursors
64354.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows scattered hematopoietic cells in a red-cell background. The arrowed neutrophil is enlarged and contains a nucleus composed of numerous small, rounded, densely staining lobes clustered in a grape-like pattern, together with multiple clear cytoplasmic vacuoles. No microorganisms are definitively identified within the vacuoles at this magnification. Findings are consistent with a vacuolated botryoid neutrophil, a reactive change in the setting of severe febrile infection such as scrub typhus.

ddx.vs: Apoptotic cells shrink and show smooth, homogeneous pyknotic fragments with a dense cytoplasm, whereas this cell is enlarged with multiple lobes retaining chromatin texture.
True phagocytosis shows discrete bacteria or yeasts within vacuoles; vacuolation alone is nonspecific and should prompt blood culture correlation.
Megaloblastic hypersegmentation produces a linear chain of lobes without vacuolation and is accompanied by macro-ovalocytes and megaloblastic precursors.

64162.recognize_zh: 低倍（10X）骨髓切片可見一條骨小樑、脂肪細胞與造血組織，右半部造血區內夾雜細胞質較淡、較大的細胞與零星巨核細胞；但在此倍率下，上皮樣細胞聚落的邊界並不明顯，需搭配高倍與免疫染色確認。
features: Bone marrow core with a long bony trabecula and interspersed adipocytes
Variably cellular hematopoietic marrow, more cellular on the right half of the field
Areas with somewhat paler, larger cells within the hematopoietic compartment (focus not sharply delineated at this power)
Scattered megakaryocytes and interstitial hemorrhage
No well-formed granulomas, fibrosis, or cohesive tumor nests identifiable at this magnification
64162.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of the bone marrow core biopsy shows a bony trabecula with adjacent marrow composed of adipose tissue and trilineage-appearing hematopoietic elements, with scattered megakaryocytes and focal hemorrhage. Areas in the right half of the field contain paler, larger cells, but a discrete focus of epithelioid cells is not sharply defined at this magnification. High-power examination and immunohistochemistry (CD163 positive, CD34 negative, dot-like AE1/AE3) are needed to characterize the epithelioid population.

ddx.vs: Granulomas form discrete, rounded aggregates of epithelioid histiocytes often with giant cells or necrosis, which are not evident in this field.
Metastatic carcinoma typically forms cohesive nests with desmoplastic stroma and shows strong diffuse keratin, rather than CD163-positive cells.
Mast cell aggregates are often paratrabecular or perivascular spindle-to-epithelioid clusters with fibrosis and are tryptase/CD117 positive.

64098.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一團緊密黏聚（cohesive）的大型非造血細胞，細胞邊界不清呈融合狀、細胞質藍色，並有數個大空泡把細胞核推擠到一側（類似印戒細胞），與周圍散在的造血細胞明顯不同，提示轉移性腺癌（胃癌）。
features: Cohesive three-dimensional cluster of large non-hematopoietic cells with indistinct, syncytial cell borders
Large nuclei with fine-to-coarse chromatin, some with visible nucleoli, and nuclear size variation
Moderately abundant basophilic cytoplasm containing large clear mucin-like vacuoles that indent nuclei (signet-ring-like)
Cluster much larger than surrounding hematopoietic cells; neutrophil and small lymphocyte nearby for scale
Background of lysed/crenated red cells and proteinaceous material
64098.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hemodilute background with scattered hematopoietic cells. There is a cohesive cluster of large atypical cells with syncytial borders, enlarged pleomorphic nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm containing large clear vacuoles, some indenting the nuclei in a signet-ring-like fashion. The cells are substantially larger than adjacent neutrophils and lymphocytes and do not resemble any normal marrow element. Findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma; correlation with the trephine biopsy and immunohistochemistry (cytokeratin, CDX2) supports a gastric primary.

ddx.vs: Osteoblasts are round-to-oval cells with eccentric nuclei and a detached perinuclear clearing (hof) arranged in loose rows, not tightly cohesive syncytial clusters with mucin vacuoles.
Megakaryocytes are single giant cells with a lobulated nucleus and granular pink cytoplasm, not groups of discrete vacuolated nuclei.

ddx.dx: Clumped leukemic or lymphoma cells (e.g., ALCL, Burkitt)
ddx.vs: Hematolymphoid cells may aggregate but lack true cohesion, and are cytokeratin-negative with CD45 or lineage marker expression.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor (neuroblastoma, rhabdomyosarcoma)
ddx.vs: These form rosettes or clumps of smaller cells with scant cytoplasm and occur mainly in children, lacking signet-ring mucin vacuoles.

exam.answer_en: Metastatic gastric carcinoma in bone marrow — cohesive cluster of large pleomorphic cells with syncytial borders and signet-ring-like vacuoles
pearls_zh: 考法：骨髓抹片中找出「不屬於骨髓的細胞團」；比較大小（遠大於旁邊嗜中性球）、黏合成團與推核空泡，答 metastatic carcinoma。
IHC 組合：pan-cytokeratin（AE1/AE3）陽性、CD45 陰性；胃腸道來源 CK7/CK20 與 CDX2，胃癌需另評估 HER2 與 PD-L1 等治療標記（通常取原發或轉移組織）。
骨髓轉移胃癌常以全血球低下、leukoerythroblastic 抹片、ALP/LDH 升高表現，可合併 DIC 與 microangiopathic hemolytic anemia，預後差。
抽吸抹片可能漏掉纖維化病灶中的腫瘤細胞，骨髓切片（trephine）的敏感度較高，懷疑轉移時必須同時取 biopsy。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤為 megakaryocyte、osteoblast 群或 blasts 聚集：osteoblast 為偏心核、有 hof 的單獨或鬆散排列細胞（似漿細胞但較大）；本團細胞邊界融合、核多形並有推核空泡，支持上皮腫瘤。

quiz.q: 骨髓抹片中這團細胞應以哪兩個 IHC 標記確認為轉移癌而非造血腫瘤？
quiz.a: Cytokeratin（如 AE1/AE3）陽性、CD45 陰性。

64034.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的巨核細胞胞質很大、淡藍色細顆粒，但核不是連在一起的分葉核，而是數個彼此分開的小圓核排列在細胞邊緣（separated nuclear lobes），是 MDS 的巨核細胞發育不良（dysmegakaryopoiesis）表現。
features: Large megakaryocyte (arrow) with abundant pale blue, finely granular cytoplasm
Multiple (about five) small, round, widely separated nuclei clustered at one edge of the cytoplasm instead of a single lobulated nucleus
Nuclei of similar size with dense chromatin
Surrounding bone marrow particle with erythroid and myeloid precursors and small lymphoid-appearing cells
Some overlap with adjacent cells, so nuclear continuity cannot be fully excluded
64034.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (Giemsa stain, high power) shows a large megakaryocyte with abundant pale, finely granular cytoplasm containing multiple small, round, widely separated nuclei grouped at one pole of the cell rather than a single multilobated nucleus. The adjacent marrow particle contains erythroid and myeloid precursors. Although overlapping cells limit certainty, the separated round nuclei are a recognized dysplastic megakaryocytic feature. Findings are consistent with dysmegakaryopoiesis, supportive of myelodysplastic neoplasm in the appropriate context.

ddx.vs: Normal megakaryocytes have a single nucleus with lobes connected by chromatin bridges, not discrete separate round nuclei.
Osteoclasts have many (often >10) uniform, oval, evenly spaced separate nuclei with nucleoli, scattered through the cytoplasm, and occur near bone spicules.

ddx.dx: Megakaryocyte with emperipolesis or overlying cells
ddx.vs: Engulfed or overlying lymphocytes and erythroblasts have their own rim of cytoplasm and variable nuclear features, unlike uniform nuclear lobes within the megakaryocyte.

ddx.dx: Reactive changes (e.g., post-chemotherapy, HIV, megaloblastic anemia)
ddx.vs: Non-clonal conditions can also produce separated lobes, so at least 10% dysplastic megakaryocytes and clonal evidence are required for MDS.

exam.answer_en: Dysplastic megakaryocyte with multiple widely separated round nuclei — dysmegakaryopoiesis supporting MDS
pearls_zh: 考法：指著巨核細胞問「哪裡發育不良」；答多個分離的小圓核（separated nuclear lobes），而非正常相連的分葉核。
巨核細胞發育不良三型要會列：micromegakaryocyte（最具特異性）、低分葉/單葉核、多個分離核；另兩系看 hypogranulation、pseudo-Pelger、多核紅系母細胞等。
MDS 形態門檻：單一系列發育不良細胞需 ≥10%；巨核細胞建議至少評估 30 顆，並排除非克隆性原因。
反應性發育不良鑑別：化療後、G-CSF、HIV、B12/葉酸缺乏、酒精、銅缺乏均可造成類似變化，形態不足時需染色體或 NGS 佐證克隆性。
exam.pitfall_zh: 多個分離核的大細胞易誤認為 osteoclast；osteoclast 核數多、大小一致且帶小核仁、各自獨立排列，巨核細胞核染色質較粗且屬血小板生成系（CD61+）。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指巨核細胞的發育不良特徵為何？MDS 中形態發育不良的比例門檻是多少？
quiz.a: 多個彼此分離的小圓核（separated nuclear lobes）；該系列 ≥10% 細胞呈發育不良

63970.recognize_zh: 整片幾乎都是異常前骨髓球（abnormal promyelocytes），細胞質塞滿粗大的紫紅色嗜天青顆粒而遮住核的輪廓，右上方細胞可見成束交錯的 Auer rods（柴束細胞，faggot cell），這是急性前骨髓球性白血病（APL）的招牌表現。
features: Sheets of large abnormal promyelocytes nearly replacing normal marrow elements
Round to oval or reniform nuclei, often partially obscured by overlying granules
Abundant cytoplasm densely packed with coarse red-purple azurophilic granules
Occasional cells with bundles of criss-crossing Auer rods (faggot cells), best seen in the upper right
Rare residual lymphocytes and small dense cells between the leukemic cells
63970.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hypercellular and composed almost entirely of large abnormal promyelocytes. These cells have round to reniform nuclei that are partly obscured by abundant cytoplasm packed with coarse azurophilic granules. Scattered cells contain bundles of Auer rods arranged in stacks (faggot cells). Residual normal hematopoiesis is scant in this field. Findings are consistent with acute promyelocytic leukemia (hypergranular type), and urgent confirmation of PML::RARA and evaluation for coagulopathy are warranted.

ddx.dx: AML with maturation (FAB M2), e.g. with t(8;21)
ddx.vs: AML with maturation shows blasts with a single slender Auer rod, perinuclear hof and maturing granulocytes, rather than sheets of hypergranular promyelocytes with multiple rod bundles.

ddx.dx: Reactive promyelocyte-rich marrow (recovery or G-CSF effect)
ddx.vs: Recovering marrow shows orderly maturation to myelocytes and neutrophils with a clear Golgi zone and no Auer rods or faggot cells.
The microgranular variant has bilobed, butterfly-shaped nuclei and sparse or dust-like granules, whereas this image shows the hypergranular form with obscured nuclei.

ddx.dx: APL-like AML with other RARA-partner or non-RARA rearrangement
ddx.vs: Morphology may be similar, so molecular testing for PML::RARA versus variants such as ZBTB16::RARA is required because some variants are ATRA-resistant.

exam.answer_en: Acute promyelocytic leukemia, hypergranular — abnormal promyelocytes with coarse granules and faggot cells (bundled Auer rods)
pearls_zh: 考法：指著含成束 Auer rods 的細胞問名稱（faggot cell），再問診斷與必做的分子檢查：t(15;17)(q24.1;q21.2) PML::RARA（FISH/RT-PCR）。
急症：APL 合併 DIC 與過度纖維蛋白溶解，早期出血死亡是主因；形態懷疑即立刻給 ATRA，不必等分子結果，並積極補充 fibrinogen 與血小板。
表型與細胞化學：MPO 強陽性；flow 典型 CD33+、CD117 常陽性、CD34-、HLA-DR-、CD11b-。
治療：非高風險（WBC ≤10×10^9/L）以 ATRA + arsenic trioxide 為標準；注意 differentiation syndrome 與 ATO 的 QTc 延長。ZBTB16::RARA 變異型對 ATRA 不敏感。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 t(8;21) AML with maturation 或 G-CSF 後前骨髓球增生混淆；APL 前骨髓球顆粒粗大遮核、有 faggot cells、CD34/HLA-DR 陰性，恢復期骨髓則有正常成熟梯度。

quiz.q: 右上方含成束 Auer rods 的細胞稱為什麼？形態懷疑此病時應立即給予何種藥物？
quiz.a: Faggot cell；立即給 ATRA（all-trans retinoic acid）並處理 DIC

63906.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的母細胞核大、染色質細緻，細胞質嗜鹼性且邊緣有不規則的泡狀突起（blebs）和像正在出芽的血小板碎片，背景可見大型與成團的異常血小板，這些是急性巨核母細胞白血病的線索。
features: Medium-to-large blasts with high N:C ratio, round nucleus and fine chromatin
Basophilic cytoplasm with irregular cytoplasmic blebs and projections resembling budding platelets (arrows)
Background with large/atypical platelets and platelet clumps
Accompanying immature granulocytes (myelocytes, metamyelocyte) and occasional echinocytes
63906.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating blasts accompanied by immature granulocytes. The blasts (arrows) are medium to large with a high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm bearing irregular blebs and pseudopod-like projections that resemble budding platelets. The background contains atypical large platelets and platelet clumps. Morphology alone is insufficient; megakaryocytic lineage must be confirmed by flow cytometry or immunohistochemistry (CD41, CD61, CD42b). Findings are suggestive of acute megakaryoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts may contain granules or Auer rods and are MPO-positive, whereas megakaryoblasts are MPO-negative and express CD41/CD61.
Lymphoblasts lack cytoplasmic blebs and platelet budding and express TdT with B- or T-lineage markers.
BPDCN cells can show pseudopod-like cytoplasmic tails but express CD4, CD56, CD123 and TCF4 and lack CD41/CD61.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round cell tumor or platelet satellitism artifact
ddx.vs: Tumor cells form cohesive clusters and are CD45-negative, and platelets adhering to cells are discrete separate particles rather than blebs continuous with blast cytoplasm.

exam.answer_en: Suggestive of acute megakaryoblastic leukemia — blasts with cytoplasmic blebs/budding platelet-like projections and atypical large platelets
pearls_zh: 考法：指著帶泡狀突起的芽細胞問系別；胞質 blebs 像出芽血小板並伴巨大血小板 → 懷疑 megakaryoblast，但形態不足以確診。
確認系別：flow 或 IHC 見 CD41、CD61、CD42b 陽性，MPO 陰性、常 CD34/CD45 表現不定；電顯 platelet peroxidase 為傳統確認法。
骨髓常因纖維化而 dry tap，芽細胞計數需依賴切片 IHC；周邊血可見循環巨核細胞碎片與巨大血小板。
兒童相關遺傳：Down syndrome 相關髓系白血病有 GATA1 突變（可先有 TAM）；非 Down 嬰兒可見 t(1;22) RBM15::MRTFA，CBFA2T3::GLIS2 預後差。
exam.pitfall_zh: 帶泡狀突起的芽細胞易誤判為 lymphoblast 或 BPDCN；lymphoblast 為 TdT+、無血小板樣突起，BPDCN 為 CD123/CD4/CD56+，megakaryoblast 需 CD41/CD61 陽性確認。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指芽細胞邊緣的泡狀突起提示哪一系分化？應以哪些標記確認？
quiz.a: 巨核細胞系（megakaryoblast）；CD41、CD61（CD42b），MPO 陰性

63842.recognize_zh: HPLC 圖中 HbA（Ao 62.6%）仍是主峰，但 3.60 分鐘 A2 視窗出現約 27.5% 的高峰，HbF 0.6%；A2 視窗內 25–30% 的變異量遠超過 β 地中海貧血帶因的 4–8%，符合 HbE 帶因（HbE trait）。
features: Cation-exchange HPLC report with peak table and chromatogram
Dominant Ao (HbA) peak at 2.37 min, 62.6%
Large A2-window peak at 3.60 min quantified at 27.5%
HbF 0.6%; small P2, P3 and unknown minor peaks
No D- or S-window variant peak
63842.describe_en: Cation-exchange HPLC shows a major HbA peak (62.6%) and a large peak eluting at 3.60 minutes in the HbA2 window, quantified at 27.5% on this printout (the figure legend cites 23.8%). HbF is 0.6% and no D- or S-window variants are present. An A2-window fraction in the 20-30% range with preserved HbA reflects a co-eluting variant, most commonly HbE, rather than true HbA2. Findings are consistent with HbE trait in the mother of the index case; alkaline electrophoresis or DNA analysis can confirm HbE.

ddx.vs: Beta-thalassemia trait raises true HbA2 only to about 4-8%, far below the 20-30% A2-window peak of HbE trait.
Hb Lepore elutes in or near the A2 window but at only about 5-15% with mildly raised HbF.

ddx.dx: HbE trait with coexisting alpha-thalassemia or iron deficiency
ddx.vs: Coinherited alpha-thalassemia or iron deficiency lowers the HbE fraction toward 20% or less, so a lower-than-expected HbE level warrants iron studies and alpha-globin testing.

exam.answer_en: HbE trait — HPLC with a large A2-window peak (~25–30%) and preserved major HbA peak
pearls_zh: HbE 在 CE-HPLC 與 HbA2 同窗共沖提，數值應判讀為 HbE+A2；A2 視窗遠高於 β-thal trait 範圍即代表變異血紅素。
HbE 為 β26 Glu→Lys，同時產生異常剪接位點，表現為輕度 β+ 地貧表型：小球性但通常無明顯貧血。
臨床意義在遺傳：HbE 帶因與 β-thal 帶因配偶，子女 1/4 為 HbE/β-thal，表型從輕度到輸血依賴。
鹼性電泳中 HbE 與 HbA2、HbC 同位置，需 HPLC 或 DNA 分析確認。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為 β-thal trait：β-thal trait 的 HbA2 只有約 4–8%，A2 視窗 25–30% 屬於 HbE。

quiz.q: A2 視窗 27.5% 最可能代表什麼？
quiz.a: HbE 與 HbA2 共沖提；HbE trait

63714.recognize_zh: 視野中可見數個兩端尖細的鐮刀狀／船形紅血球（sickle / boat-shaped cells），夾雜標靶細胞（target cells）與濃縮緻密的紅血球，許多紅血球內有細小深色顆粒（Pappenheimer bodies），符合鐮刀型貧血的血片。
features: Scattered sickle (drepanocyte) and boat-shaped red cells with pointed or tapered ends
Target cells and folded/irregular poikilocytes
Marked anisopoikilocytosis with dense, hyperchromatic small cells
Fine dark basophilic granules at the periphery of some red cells, consistent with Pappenheimer bodies
Occasional single larger dark dot resembling a Howell-Jolly body
Platelets present; no nucleated cells in this field
63714.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with scattered elongated sickle cells and boat-shaped cells with tapered ends. Target cells, dense irregularly contracted cells and folded poikilocytes are also present. Several red cells contain small peripheral basophilic granules consistent with Pappenheimer bodies, and an occasional Howell-Jolly body-like inclusion is seen, compatible with functional hyposplenism. Findings are consistent with sickle cell anemia.

ddx.vs: HbSC shows fewer classic sickle cells and characteristic crystal-containing cells (folded 'Washington monument' or glove-shaped crystals) with abundant target cells; hemoglobin electrophoresis/HPLC separates them.
Sickle beta-thalassemia has more microcytosis and hypochromia with target cells, and HbA2 elevation with or without HbA on HPLC distinguishes it.
Elliptocytes have rounded blunt ends and a uniform oval shape, lacking the pointed ends and dense hemoglobin of sickle cells.
Sideroblastic anemia shows dimorphic hypochromic cells with Pappenheimer bodies but no sickle forms, with ring sideroblasts in the marrow.

exam.answer_en: Sickle cell anemia — sickle and boat-shaped cells with target cells and Pappenheimer/Howell-Jolly bodies (hyposplenism)
pearls_zh: 考法：指兩端尖的細胞問名稱，並指紅血球內小顆粒問 Pappenheimer 或 Howell-Jolly body，連結功能性無脾。
HbS 為 β6 Glu→Val，去氧時聚合；HbSS 的 HPLC 以 HbS 為主、無 HbA，HbF 高低不等。
反覆脾梗塞造成 autosplenectomy，易感染莢膜菌（如肺炎鏈球菌），孩童需疫苗與 penicillin 預防。
治療：hydroxyurea 提升 HbF；急性胸部症候群或中風需輸血或換血。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 HbSC：HbSC 典型鐮刀細胞較少、標靶細胞多，並有手指狀或手套狀結晶，需 HPLC 分辨。

quiz.q: 紅血球內的小顆粒（Howell-Jolly/Pappenheimer）提示什麼脾臟狀態？
quiz.a: 功能性無脾（autosplenectomy）

63650.recognize_zh: CellaVision 影像中淋巴球中等大小、核不規則，部分有明顯核仁與細胞質泡狀突起（bleb）；流式圖顯示這群 T 細胞 CD45 表現高低不一，表面 CD3 陰性、細胞質 CD3 陽性、TdT 陰性，CD2、CD5、CD7 陽性且 CD4+/CD8−。
features: (a) Medium-sized atypical lymphocytes with irregular nuclear contours, moderately condensed chromatin, and basophilic agranular cytoplasm
(a) Some cells with cytoplasmic blebs, a visible nucleolus, or more abundant cytoplasm
(b) CD45 vs side scatter: low-SSC population split into CD45-negative, dim-moderate, and bright subsets
(c, d) CD5 positive, surface CD3 negative; cytoplasmic CD3 positive, TdT negative
(e-g) CD2 and CD7 positive; CD4 positive, CD8 negative; CD25 and CD56 negative
63650.describe_en: Composite of peripheral blood morphology and flow cytometry. The CellaVision images (a) show medium-sized atypical lymphocytes with irregular nuclear outlines, basophilic agranular cytoplasm, focal cytoplasmic blebs, and occasional visible nucleoli. Flow cytometric dot plots show a dominant low side-scatter population with heterogeneous CD45 expression (negative, dim-moderate, and bright subsets) that is surface CD3 negative, cytoplasmic CD3 positive, TdT negative, CD5, CD2 and CD7 positive, CD4 positive/CD8 negative, and CD25 and CD56 negative. Loss of CD45 on a subset is a gating pitfall that can mimic an immature or non-hematopoietic population. Together with marked lymphocytosis, findings are consistent with T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia; demonstration of TCL1A or MTCP1 rearrangement or TCL1 overexpression is recommended.

ddx.vs: T-ALL blasts are also cytoplasmic CD3 positive/surface CD3 negative but express TdT, CD1a, or CD34, all negative here.
Sézary cells have cerebriform nuclei and are CD4 positive with frequent CD7 and CD26 loss, whereas T-PLL usually retains bright CD7.
ATLL shows polylobated flower cells, strong CD25 expression, and HTLV-1 positivity, while this population is CD25 negative.
T-LGL cells have abundant cytoplasm with azurophilic granules and are usually CD8 and CD57 positive.

63586.recognize_zh: 箭頭處巨大細胞內有約七個彼此分離、大小一致的橢圓形核，胞質豐富呈藍紫色並散布細小紫紅顆粒、邊緣不規則，這是骨髓抽吸中的破骨細胞（osteoclast），與核分葉相連的巨核細胞不同。
features: Very large multinucleated giant cell with about seven discrete, separate nuclei
Nuclei uniform, round to oval, with fine to moderately clumped chromatin and small nucleoli
Abundant blue-lavender cytoplasm with fine scattered azurophilic granules and a frayed irregular border
No nuclear lobes connected to one another (unlike a megakaryocyte)
Background of maturing granulocytes, erythroid precursors, lymphocytes, a plasma cell and red cells
63586.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (May-Grünwald-Giemsa) shows a large multinucleated giant cell containing approximately seven separate, uniform oval nuclei with small nucleoli, set in abundant blue-lavender cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules and irregular margins. The surrounding marrow cells show normal-appearing granulocytic and erythroid elements. No atypia is present in the giant cell nuclei. Findings are consistent with a normal osteoclast.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have a single multilobated nucleus with interconnected lobes and pink granular cytoplasm with platelet budding, whereas osteoclast nuclei are completely separate and uniform.
Multinucleated plasma cells have few nuclei with clock-face chromatin in deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm with a hof.

ddx.dx: Tumor giant cells (metastatic carcinoma, Reed-Sternberg cells)
ddx.vs: Tumor giant cells show nuclear pleomorphism, variable nuclear size and large prominent nucleoli rather than uniform bland nuclei.

exam.answer_en: Normal osteoclast — multinucleated giant cell with about seven separate uniform nuclei and granular cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考官指巨大多核細胞問是巨核細胞還是破骨細胞：破骨細胞核彼此分離、大小一致；巨核細胞為單一相連的分葉核。
破骨細胞源自單核球/巨噬細胞系前驅細胞融合；TRAP（tartrate-resistant acid phosphatase）陽性、CD68+。
抽吸中破骨細胞增加見於骨轉換上升：副甲狀腺機能亢進、Paget disease、骨轉移、骨髓瘤骨病變。
破骨細胞經 RANKL 路徑活化；denosumab（anti-RANKL）與 bisphosphonate 抑制破骨細胞，用於骨髓瘤骨病。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為多葉巨核細胞；破骨細胞多個核分離且各有小核仁，巨核細胞則是單一相連多葉核、無明顯核仁，胞質可見血小板出芽。

quiz.q: 此多核巨細胞是什麼？與巨核細胞如何區分？
quiz.a: Osteoclast；核彼此分離（巨核細胞為單一相連分葉核）

63522.recognize_zh: 視野中兩顆中型淋巴球，染色質緻密、細胞質少且無顆粒，細胞核都有深凹痕把核分成兩葉，可認出雙葉淋巴球（bilobed lymphocyte）。
features: Two medium-sized lymphocytes, about 1.5 times red cell diameter
High N:C ratio with a thin rim of pale, agranular cytoplasm
Nuclei indented by a deep cleft producing two lobes
Mature, coarsely condensed chromatin; no nucleoli
Background normocytic red cells with a few elongated/oval forms and normal-appearing platelets
63522.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic normochromic red cells with occasional oval forms and adequate platelets. Two medium-sized lymphocytes are present, each with scant agranular cytoplasm and a nucleus deeply cleaved into two lobes with mature condensed chromatin and no visible nucleoli. No blasts or atypical granulation are seen. Findings are consistent with bilobed lymphocytes; if numerous or accompanied by lymphocytosis, flow cytometry should be considered to exclude a lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.vs: Flower cells have multiple petal-like nuclear lobes and occur in the setting of HTLV-1 with lymphocytosis, rather than simple two-lobed nuclei.
Sézary cells show cerebriform nuclei with fine convoluted grooves instead of one deep cleft.
Band neutrophils have abundant cytoplasm with fine neutrophilic granules and a horseshoe-shaped nucleus, unlike the scant agranular cytoplasm here.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell or small cleaved lymphoma cell
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells are usually clonal on flow cytometry and hairy cells have abundant cytoplasm with circumferential projections, which are absent here.

63074.recognize_zh: MUM1 染色中，許多小型細胞核呈深棕色強陽性，而散在的大型 LP 細胞核只呈淡至中度棕色，比背景小細胞弱；大細胞 MUM1 弱陽性、分布在小淋巴球結節中，符合 NLPHL 的 LP 細胞。
features: Immunohistochemical stain for MUM1/IRF4 at medium power
Numerous small cells with strong dark brown nuclear MUM1 staining (activated T cells/plasma cells)
Scattered large cells with big vesicular nuclei showing weak to moderate nuclear MUM1 staining, weaker than the small cells
Occasional large cells with multilobated or binucleate-appearing nuclei
Background MUM1-negative small lymphocytes forming a vague nodular distribution
63074.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for MUM1 shows numerous small cells with strong nuclear positivity scattered throughout a background of MUM1-negative small lymphocytes. Interspersed large cells with vesicular, sometimes lobulated nuclei show weak to moderate nuclear MUM1 staining, noticeably weaker than the reactive small cells. This weak, variable MUM1 expression in the large cells is compatible with LP cells. Findings are consistent with nodular lymphocyte predominant Hodgkin lymphoma when correlated with CD20, OCT2, BOB1 positivity and CD30/CD15 negativity in the large cells.

ddx.vs: HRS cells are typically strongly and uniformly MUM1-positive and additionally CD30/CD15-positive with loss of OCT2/BOB1, whereas LP cells here show weaker MUM1.
Large cells can have similar MUM1 staining; separation depends on architecture (diffuse, loss of nodules and follicular dendritic cell meshworks, few small B cells).
PTGC nodules contain mantle B cells and residual germinal center cells but lack the scattered large atypical LP cells seen here.

63266.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一群成簇的大細胞，細胞核圓至橢圓、偏向一側，染色質細緻，細胞質豐富呈灰藍色、邊界模糊，部分細胞質內可見離核較遠的淡染區；這種成群排列、淡染區不緊貼核旁的特徵是造骨細胞（osteoblast），可與漿細胞區分。
features: Cohesive cluster of large cells (roughly 2-3 times the size of the adjacent small lymphocyte)
Round to oval, eccentrically placed nuclei with low N:C ratio
Finely granular, evenly distributed chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
Abundant gray-blue to basophilic cytoplasm with indistinct cell borders
Pale clear zone within the cytoplasm, separated from the nucleus
Background of dense blue-staining particle/stromal material
63266.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cohesive cluster of large cells with abundant, gray-blue cytoplasm and poorly defined cell borders. Nuclei are round to oval and eccentrically placed, with finely granular chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. Several cells show a pale cytoplasmic clear zone located away from the nuclear membrane. The cells lack the coarse clock-face chromatin and juxtanuclear hof of plasma cells, and there is no nuclear pleomorphism or mitotic activity to suggest a metastatic tumor. Findings are consistent with a cluster of osteoblasts.

ddx.vs: Plasma cells are smaller, occur singly rather than in cohesive sheets, have coarse clock-face chromatin, and their perinuclear hof lies immediately adjacent to the nucleus rather than at a distance from it.
Carcinoma clusters show nuclear pleomorphism, high N:C ratio, prominent nucleoli and nuclear molding, unlike the uniform bland nuclei of osteoblasts.
Osteoclasts are much larger multinucleated cells with many separate, uniform nuclei in a single cytoplasm, whereas osteoblasts are mononuclear cells grouped together.
Erythroid precursors have centrally placed round nuclei, deeply basophilic cytoplasm and a higher N:C ratio, and do not form cohesive sheets with indistinct borders.

exam.answer_en: Osteoblasts in bone marrow aspirate — cohesive cluster of large cells with eccentric nuclei and a pale Golgi zone set away from the nucleus
pearls_zh: 考法：幾乎都是「漿細胞 vs 造骨細胞」：造骨細胞較大、成群出現、染色質細緻，淡染區（Golgi zone）與核有一段距離；漿細胞核旁淡染區緊貼核。
常見情境：兒童與青少年骨髓（骨骼生長活躍）、骨折癒合、副甲狀腺機能亢進、Paget disease 或骨轉移附近的抽吸。
另一需區分的骨細胞是 osteoclast：巨大多核、各核分離且大小一致；勿與 megakaryocyte（單一多葉核）混淆。
若仍難分辨，漿細胞以 CD138/CD38 與 kappa/lambda 輕鏈限制確認；造骨細胞 alkaline phosphatase 強陽性。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常被誤認為成群的骨髓瘤細胞或轉移癌；造骨細胞核溫和一致、淡染區遠離核，雖成簇但無核多形性或明顯核仁。

quiz.q: 這群細胞與漿細胞最關鍵的形態鑑別點是什麼？
quiz.a: 淡染區（Golgi zone）位置遠離細胞核（漿細胞緊貼核旁），且造骨細胞較大、成群出現

63202.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片中，在大量造血細胞之間散布許多大型、圓形、胞質淡灰紫且呈細泡沫狀的巨噬細胞（foamy macrophage），核小而偏位；數量這麼多，提示貯積症。
features: Numerous large macrophages, several times the size of surrounding hematopoietic cells, scattered throughout a cellular particle
Abundant pale gray-lilac, finely vacuolated foamy cytoplasm
Small round, often eccentric nuclei
Background cellular hematopoiesis with many small clear fat droplets in a thick smear area
63202.describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow aspirate particle shows cellular hematopoiesis with numerous large histiocytes scattered throughout. The macrophages have abundant pale gray-lilac, finely vacuolated, foamy cytoplasm and small round, eccentric nuclei. The thick area contains many small fat droplets, which limit cytologic detail at this magnification. Findings are suggestive of a storage disorder with foamy macrophages, such as Niemann-Pick disease, in the appropriate clinical context.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have fibrillary 'wrinkled tissue paper' cytoplasm rather than round bubbly vacuoles.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain blue-green ceroid granules; they may coexist with foamy cells in Niemann-Pick disease.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher or lipid-laden macrophages (high cell turnover, hyperlipidemia, TPN)
ddx.vs: These are fewer, occur in a relevant hematologic or clinical setting, and acid sphingomyelinase activity is normal.
Fat cells appear as large empty clear spaces without nucleus-bearing granular or foamy cytoplasm.

62882.recognize_zh: 腸胃道黏膜固有層被密集的小型淋巴球浸潤，細胞核小、深染、圓至稍不規則，異型性輕微，並散在嗜酸性球；鄰近腺體保留而無明顯的淋巴上皮破壞，這種「單調小淋巴球、低度異型」的表現符合 indolent T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder，但需免疫染色與 TCR 克隆性確認。
features: Dense, monotonous lamina propria infiltrate of small lymphocytes
Small round to slightly irregular, hyperchromatic nuclei with minimal cytologic atypia and no prominent nucleoli
Scant cytoplasm; rare mitoses and no necrosis evident
Scattered eosinophils and occasional plasma cells
Adjacent crypt epithelium with goblet cells preserved without obvious lymphoepithelial destruction
62882.describe_en: Gastrointestinal mucosal biopsy at high power shows the lamina propria expanded by a dense, relatively monotonous infiltrate of small lymphocytes with round to slightly irregular hyperchromatic nuclei, inconspicuous nucleoli, and scant cytoplasm. Scattered eosinophils and plasma cells are admixed, and the adjacent crypts with goblet cells are preserved without evident lymphoepithelial lesions or epitheliotropism. Large atypical cells, necrosis, and brisk mitotic activity are not seen. The findings are compatible with indolent T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder of the gastrointestinal tract in the appropriate immunophenotypic (usually CD4+ or CD8+, low Ki-67) and clonal TCR context.

ddx.vs: Cells are medium-sized with marked epitheliotropism, CD8+/CD56+, high Ki-67, and often form ulcerated mass lesions.
Composed of pleomorphic medium to large cells with necrosis and background celiac enteropathy.
B-cell infiltrate (CD20+) of centrocyte-like or monocytoid cells with lymphoepithelial lesions and often plasmacytic differentiation.

ddx.dx: Chronic inflammatory bowel disease or reactive infiltrate
ddx.vs: Polymorphous infiltrate with crypt distortion, cryptitis, and basal plasmacytosis, and polyclonal TCR/IG studies.

62818.recognize_zh: 觸摸抹片中倍（400x）下，視野內大量核偏位、胞質淡藍豐富的漿細胞樣細胞散佈，數量遠多於夾雜的小型深染細胞，顯示骨髓被單一形態的腫瘤細胞大量取代；外觀像漿細胞，但仍需免疫染色排除轉移性癌。
features: Touch preparation at intermediate power showing numerous discohesive plasmacytoid cells
Eccentric round nuclei with moderately condensed but not clock-face chromatin
Moderate to abundant pale blue cytoplasm; occasional cells with cytoplasmic clearing
Cells dominate the field, outnumbering small mature lymphoid/erythroid cells
Background amorphous brown extracellular material and fat droplet spaces
62818.describe_en: Touch preparation of the bone marrow core at intermediate magnification shows abundant, predominantly discohesive plasmacytoid cells with eccentric round nuclei and moderate to abundant pale blue cytoplasm, greatly outnumbering the residual small hematopoietic cells. Occasional cells show cytoplasmic clearing, and amorphous brown extracellular material and fat droplet spaces are present in the background. The picture indicates extensive marrow replacement by a monomorphic plasmacytoid population. Distinguishing a plasma cell neoplasm from a plasmacytoid metastatic carcinoma requires immunohistochemistry, which in this case supported metastatic carcinoma.

ddx.vs: Myeloma cells show a perinuclear hof, clock-face chromatin and cytoplasmic kappa or lambda restriction, which were absent in this neoplasm.
Supported by cytokeratin, GATA3 and ER positivity with cytoplasmic p120, despite the plasmacytoid cytology.
LPL contains a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells rather than a monomorphic population of large plasmacytoid cells.

ddx.dx: Rhabdomyosarcoma or other small round cell tumor
ddx.vs: Alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma can mimic plasma cells in marrow but is myogenin/desmin positive and occurs mostly in young patients.

62754.recognize_zh: 子宮內膜息肉在低倍下看似良性，但箭頭處血管內塞滿大型異型淋巴細胞；免疫染色中陽性的腫瘤細胞被局限在內皮標記勾勒出的血管腔內，IGH PCR 呈單一克隆峰，符合血管內大 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Low power: endometrial polyp stroma with hemorrhage and focal vessels showing hypercellular lumens (arrows)
Vascular lumen distended by large atypical lymphoid cells with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli
Membranous immunostaining of large neoplastic cells confined within vascular spaces
Endothelial immunostain outlines vessel walls surrounding the intraluminal tumor cells
IGH PCR (FR1, FR2) shows dominant monoclonal peaks
62754.describe_en: Sections of an endometrial polyp show, at low power, stroma with hemorrhage and scattered vessels whose lumens appear hypercellular (arrows). At high power, the vessels are filled by large atypical lymphoid cells with vesicular nuclei, prominent nucleoli, and brisk mitotic activity, without a significant extravascular mass. Immunostains show strong membranous positivity of the intraluminal tumor cells, and an endothelial marker outlines the vascular walls confining them; the specific antibodies are not labeled in the image. IGH PCR demonstrates monoclonal rearrangement in FR1 and FR2. Findings are consistent with intravascular large B-cell lymphoma involving an endometrial polyp.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma with secondary vascular invasion
ddx.vs: DLBCL forms a solid extravascular mass with only incidental vascular spread, whereas IVLBCL cells are restricted to vessel lumens.
Intravascular NK/T-cell lymphoma is CD20-negative, CD3/CD56-positive, and EBER-positive, rather than a clonal B-cell population on IGH PCR.

ddx.dx: Leukemic cells or marginated leukocytes in vessels
ddx.vs: Circulating leukocytes are mixed small mature cells, not a monotonous population of large atypical B cells packing the lumen.

ddx.dx: Intravascular carcinoma or lymphovascular tumor emboli
ddx.vs: Carcinoma emboli form cohesive keratin-positive epithelial clusters, whereas lymphoma cells are discohesive and CD45/CD20-positive.

62690.recognize_zh: 視野中央為一顆大顆粒淋巴球（large granular lymphocyte）：核圓略有凹陷、染色質濃縮，細胞質豐富淡藍，內含細小嗜天青顆粒（azurophilic granules）；在 NK 細胞慢性增生性疾患中，血液中這類細胞持續增多。
features: Medium-to-large lymphocyte with low-to-moderate N:C ratio
Round to slightly indented/reniform nucleus with condensed chromatin, no visible nucleolus
Abundant pale blue cytoplasm containing fine, sparse azurophilic granules
Background red cells with ovalocytes and occasional crenated cells; platelets present
No blasts or atypical nuclear features in this field
62690.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large granular lymphocyte with a round to slightly indented nucleus, mature condensed chromatin and abundant pale blue cytoplasm containing fine azurophilic granules. No cytologic atypia or nucleoli are seen. Background red cells include ovalocytes and a few crenated forms, and platelets are present. A single cell cannot establish clonality or lineage; a persistent large granular lymphocytosis with an NK phenotype (CD3-negative, CD16/CD56-positive, restricted KIR expression) is required. Findings are consistent with a large granular lymphocyte and, in context, suggestive of chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells.

ddx.vs: Morphologically identical; distinguished by surface CD3 and CD8 expression with clonal TCR gene rearrangement and frequent STAT3 mutation.

ddx.dx: Reactive large granular lymphocytosis (viral infection, post-splenectomy, post-transplant)
ddx.vs: Cells look the same; reactive expansions are transient and polyclonal without restricted KIR or TCR clonality.
Shows more atypical cells with irregular nuclei, open chromatin and nucleoli, is EBV-positive and presents with a fulminant clinical course.

exam.answer_en: Large granular lymphocyte, consistent with chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells in context — fine azurophilic granules, mature chromatin
pearls_zh: 考法：單一 LGL 問細胞名稱與「單憑形態能否診斷」；答案是不能，需持續性 LGL 增多加上 flow 證實 NK 表型與克隆性。
反應性 LGL 增多常見於病毒感染、脾切除後、移植後、使用 dasatinib，多為暫時性且多株。
克隆性評估：T-LGL 以 TRB/TRG 重組或 TRBC1 flow；NK 以 KIR（CD158 家族）限制性表現。
Aggressive NK-cell leukemia 需鑑別：EBV 陽性、年輕、快速惡化（發燒、肝脾腫、DIC），細胞較不成熟。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把正常反應性 LGL 過度診斷為白血病；需確認數量持續增加（數月）並證明 NK 表型與 KIR 限制，單顆細胞不足以下診斷。

quiz.q: 圖中這種淋巴球要確定為 NK 細胞克隆性增生，需要哪兩類 flow 證據？
quiz.a: NK 表型（sCD3−、CD16+/CD56+）與 KIR 限制性表現

62626.recognize_zh: HHV8 染色低倍圖：表面為鱗狀上皮，其下水腫的真皮/黏膜下組織中有許多散在的棕色細胞核陽性細胞，表示 HHV8 感染細胞浸潤於組織中（體腔外型 PEL）。
features: Low-power IHC (scale bar 200 µm) with squamous epithelium along the left edge, unstained
Numerous scattered nuclear HHV8 (LANA)-positive cells throughout the underlying edematous stroma
Positive cells are dispersed singly rather than forming cohesive sheets at this power
Loose stroma with irregular clear spaces; hematoxylin-negative cells in background
62626.describe_en: HHV8 (LANA-1) immunohistochemistry at low power shows an unremarkable surface squamous epithelium overlying edematous stroma that contains numerous scattered cells with nuclear HHV8 positivity. The positive cells are distributed diffusely as single cells through the stroma. At this magnification cytologic detail is limited and a vasoformative lesion cannot be entirely excluded on this image alone. In the context of a large-cell lymphoma lacking B-cell markers, the findings support tissue (extracavitary) involvement by HHV8-positive primary effusion lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Kaposi sarcoma cells are HHV8-positive spindle cells forming slit-like vascular channels and express CD31/CD34/ERG, whereas PEL cells are large round CD45+ plasmablastic cells lacking vascular markers.

ddx.dx: HHV8-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS
ddx.vs: HHV8+ DLBCL often arises from multicentric Castleman disease, expresses IgM lambda and is EBV-negative, whereas PEL typically lacks Ig and is often EBV-positive.
Plasmablastic lymphoma has similar CD20-negative plasmablastic cells but is HHV8/LANA-negative.

62562.recognize_zh: 四格組圖：低倍淋巴結保留部分殘存濾泡、其間被瀰漫浸潤取代；高倍可見大型多形細胞，胞質豐富嗜酸性，箭頭處為腎形／馬蹄形核的標誌細胞（hallmark cell），是 ALCL 的關鍵線索。
features: Large pleomorphic cells with abundant eosinophilic to amphophilic cytoplasm
Hallmark cells with eccentric horseshoe- or kidney-shaped nuclei and paranuclear eosinophilic region (arrows)
Vesicular to hyperchromatic chromatin with small to distinct nucleoli; occasional multinucleated forms
Cohesive sheets of tumor cells effacing the node, with residual darker lymphoid follicles at low power
Tumor extends beneath a thickened fibrous capsule with a spindled/streaming growth pattern in one panel
62562.describe_en: Composite H&E images of lymph node show, at low power, a thickened capsule and residual dark-staining lymphoid follicles set within a diffuse, paler infiltrate that effaces much of the parenchyma. At intermediate power the infiltrate forms cohesive sheets with focal spindled, streaming areas beneath the capsule. High power shows large pleomorphic cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and irregular nuclei, including hallmark cells with eccentric horseshoe- or kidney-shaped nuclei (arrows) and bizarre hyperchromatic forms. Findings are consistent with anaplastic large cell lymphoma, with confirmation by strong uniform CD30 and ALK immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: CHL has scattered Reed-Sternberg cells in a mixed inflammatory background rather than cohesive sheets of hallmark cells, and is PAX5 weak-positive and ALK-negative.
Cohesive sinusoidal growth can mimic carcinoma, but ALCL is keratin- and S100/SOX10-negative and CD30/ALK-positive.
PTCL-NOS lacks uniform strong CD30 in hallmark cells and is ALK-negative.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, anaplastic variant
ddx.vs: Anaplastic DLBCL expresses B-cell markers (CD20, PAX5) and is ALK-negative.

exam.answer_en: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma, ALK-positive — large pleomorphic cells with horseshoe/kidney-shaped hallmark cells effacing lymph node
pearls_zh: 考法：箭頭指腎形/馬蹄形核、核旁嗜酸性區的 hallmark cell，問診斷與下一步 IHC（CD30、ALK）；所有型態亞型都能看到 hallmark cells。
遺傳：最常見 t(2;5)(p23;q35) NPM1::ALK，ALK IHC 呈核加胞質陽性；其他夥伴基因多只有胞質染色。
表型：CD30 強陽性（膜與 Golgi），EMA 常陽性，常失去多數 T 細胞抗原（CD3 常陰性），細胞毒性標記 TIA1/granzyme B/perforin 陽性。
臨床：好發兒童與年輕人，預後優於 ALK 陰性 ALCL；CD30 為 brentuximab vedotin 標靶，復發者可考慮 ALK 抑制劑（如 crizotinib）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為轉移性癌或 classic Hodgkin lymphoma：癌 keratin 陽性；cHL 的 HRS 細胞 CD15+、PAX5 弱陽性且背景為混合發炎細胞；ALCL 成片生長、ALK+、PAX5 陰性。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指核呈馬蹄形的細胞稱為什麼？最常見的相關易位為何？
quiz.a: Hallmark cell；t(2;5)(p23;q35) NPM1::ALK

62498.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片幾乎被小型成熟淋巴球佔滿，核圓、染色質塊狀、細胞質少；箭頭指出較大、有明顯核仁的前淋巴球（prolymphocyte），右上有一個巨核細胞，另可見破碎的塗抹細胞，符合 CLL 骨髓浸潤。
features: Marked predominance of small mature lymphocytes replacing normal hematopoiesis
Round nuclei with coarsely clumped chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm
Scattered larger prolymphocytes with a single prominent central nucleolus (arrows)
Occasional smudge cells and streaked nuclear material
Residual megakaryocyte and rare myeloid/erythroid precursors
62498.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is markedly cellular and composed predominantly of small mature lymphocytes with round nuclei, clumped chromatin, and scant cytoplasm, replacing normal hematopoietic elements. Scattered larger cells with a prominent central nucleolus consistent with prolymphocytes are present (arrows), along with smudge cells. A megakaryocyte and rare residual myeloid and erythroid precursors are seen. Findings are consistent with extensive marrow involvement by chronic lymphocytic leukemia; the proportion of prolymphocytes should be quantified, since trisomy 12 CLL often shows atypical morphology.

ddx.vs: MCL cells have more irregular, cleaved nuclei with less clumped chromatin and are CD23-negative and cyclin D1-positive.
B-PLL requires more than 55% prolymphocytes, whereas prolymphocytes here are a minority among small lymphocytes.
These show plasmacytoid cells or villous cytoplasm and are usually CD5- and CD23-negative.
Hematogones have fine homogeneous chromatin without nucleoli and show a maturing, non-clonal immunophenotype.

62370.recognize_zh: G 帶染色核型圖中第 7 號染色體只有一條（monosomy 7），性染色體為 XY；3 號染色體兩條外觀不對稱，配合病例提示 3q 重組，而 −7 是 inv(3)/t(3;3) AML 最常見的附加異常。
features: G-banded karyotype arranged 1-22, X, Y from a male (XY)
Only one chromosome 7 present, consistent with monosomy 7
Chromosome 3 homologs appear unequal in length and banding, suggestive of a 3q structural rearrangement
Low band resolution and blurred image limit confirmation of the exact 3q21/3q26 breakpoints
62370.describe_en: G-banded karyotype image shows a male complement with a single chromosome 7, consistent with monosomy 7. The two chromosome 3 homologs appear morphologically dissimilar, suggestive of a structural abnormality involving 3q, although band resolution in this image is insufficient to define the breakpoints. In the context of this case the karyotype is interpreted as a 3q21q26 rearrangement (inv(3)/t(3;3)) with monosomy 7, the most frequent secondary abnormality in this AML subtype and a marker of adverse prognosis. The ISCN nomenclature from the cytogenetics report should be used for final documentation.

ddx.vs: Isolated -7 shows two normal chromosome 3 homologs, whereas a 3q26 rearrangement defines the inv(3)/t(3;3) entity.
t(3;21) involves exchange between chromosomes 3 and 21 with an abnormal chromosome 21, often therapy-related or in CML blast phase.

62178.recognize_zh: 流式細胞儀 CD4 對 CD14 點圖中，右上閘門為 CD4 弱陽性且 CD14 明亮的細胞（標示 19.62%，作者稱為晚期前單核球），右下另有一大群 CD4 陽性但 CD14 陰性的族群，代表較不成熟的單核球系細胞，呈現單核球分化的連續光譜。
features: Flow cytometry dot plot of CD4 (x-axis) versus CD14 (y-axis), both log scale, singlet-gated
Upper gate labeled 'Promonocytes: 19.62%' containing CD4 dim-to-moderate, CD14 bright cells
Large CD4-positive, CD14-negative population in the lower right quadrant
Intermediate CD14 partially positive population bridging the two (maturation continuum)
CD4-negative, CD14-negative events in the lower left (lymphocytes/other cells)
62178.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot of peripheral blood singlets displays CD4 versus CD14. A gated population comprising 19.62% of events shows dim to moderate CD4 with bright CD14, labeled by the submitter as late promonocytes. A larger CD4-positive, CD14-negative population is present in the lower right, with intermediate CD14 expression bridging the two groups, consistent with a spectrum of monocytic maturation. Note that bright CD14 is usually a feature of mature monocytes, so the promonocyte versus monocyte distinction must be made morphologically, while CD4+ CD14− cells may represent monoblasts/promonocytes or T cells requiring CD3 and CD64 for separation. In context, the findings support acute monocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: CMML shows mostly mature CD14+ monocytes with an increased classical (CD14+/CD16−) fraction and <20% blasts plus promonocytes by morphology, whereas acute monocytic leukemia has ≥20% monoblasts/promonocytes.
Reactive monocytes have a normal maturation pattern and normal CD14/CD16 subset distribution without aberrant antigen expression or increased immature monocytic cells.

62050.recognize_zh: 紅色免疫染色低倍下，陽性細胞聚集成彼此相連、形狀不規則的蛇行狀或模糊結節帶，與陰性小淋巴球區交錯分布，並散在環狀陽性結構，顯示 NLPHL 中不典型（serpiginous/interconnected）的結節型態。
features: Positive cells concentrated in ill-defined, interconnected serpiginous nodular bands
Intervening broad zones of negative small lymphocytes
Positive cells small to intermediate with membranous red staining; scattered ring-like larger positive profiles
No sharply circumscribed follicles or mantle zones
Cytologic detail limited at this magnification; antibody identity not labeled
62050.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (red chromogen, antibody not specified in the image) of lymph node at low power shows positive cells aggregated in ill-defined, interconnected serpiginous bands and vague nodules, separated by broad zones of negative small lymphocytes. Scattered ring-like positive profiles are present within the positive zones, but individual cytology cannot be assessed at this magnification. No sharply circumscribed follicles with mantle zones are recognized. In a case of nodular lymphocyte predominant Hodgkin lymphoma, this appearance fits a serpiginous/interconnected nodular or extranodular variant pattern; the specific marker and correlation with CD20, CD3, PD-1 and CD21 staining are required for interpretation.

ddx.vs: PTGC forms discrete, round, enlarged nodules of small B cells amid reactive follicles, not interconnected serpiginous bands with LP cells.
Follicular lymphoma shows back-to-back rounded follicles of BCL2+ CD10+ cells rather than irregular serpiginous zones.
Nodular LRCHL can mimic this architecture, but its large cells are CD30+/CD15+ HRS cells within expanded mantle zones.
THRLBCL lacks nodular or serpiginous B-cell compartments and has a purely diffuse T-cell-rich background.

61986.recognize_zh: DUSP22 分離式（break-apart）FISH：DAPI 藍色背景中兩個細胞核，上方核可見兩個融合（黃/紅綠重疊）訊號，下方核有一個融合訊號與一個分離的紅色訊號；出現分離訊號代表 DUSP22 (6p25.3) 重排，是乳房植入物相關 ALCL 的遺傳學特徵之一。
features: Interphase FISH on two DAPI-counterstained nuclei using a DUSP22 break-apart probe
Upper nucleus: two fused or closely apposed red-green (yellow) signals, a normal pattern
Lower nucleus: one fused signal and one separate predominantly red signal, suggesting a split (rearranged) pattern
Signals are small and the image resolution limits confident scoring of individual nuclei
Diagnostic interpretation requires scoring of many nuclei against a validated cutoff
61986.describe_en: Interphase fluorescence in situ hybridization with a DUSP22 (6p25.3) break-apart probe shows two DAPI-counterstained nuclei. One nucleus shows two fused signals, whereas the other shows one fused signal and one separate predominantly red signal, suggesting separation of the probe halves consistent with DUSP22 rearrangement. Resolution is limited, and a definitive result requires enumerating an adequate number of tumor nuclei against the laboratory cutoff. In the context of CD30-positive, ALK-negative T-cell lymphoma, DUSP22 rearrangement is a recurrent finding in breast implant-associated ALCL and defines a prognostically distinct subset of ALK-negative ALCL.

ddx.vs: TP63 rearrangement is detected with a TP63 probe or RNA fusion assay, carries a poor prognosis, and is mutually exclusive with DUSP22 rearrangement in most cases.
ALK-positive ALCL shows ALK protein by IHC and ALK (2p23) break-apart FISH, typically NPM1::ALK, and is ALK-negative on this case's IHC.
