Single neutrophil with a lobulated nucleus and pale granular cytoplasm
Platelets present but sparse
3170.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a striking population of red cells that are dense and lack central pallor, bearing a variable number of irregularly distributed spicules of unequal length. Occasional small dense round cells without projections are also present. A neutrophil and rare platelets are seen. Findings are consistent with marked acanthocytosis; clinical correlation for abetalipoproteinemia, neuroacanthocytosis, severe liver disease (spur cell anemia) or McLeod phenotype is suggested.

ddx.vs: Echinocytes have 10-30 short, evenly spaced, regular projections and retain central pallor, often as a drying artifact or in uremia, whereas acanthocytes have fewer irregular spicules.
Keratocytes have one or two horn-like projections flanking a ruptured vacuole, reflecting microangiopathic injury, not multiple irregular spicules.
Spherocytes are small dense cells without projections, while acanthocytes, although dense, bear irregular spiky extensions.

exam.answer_en: Marked acanthocytosis — dense red cells without central pallor bearing irregular spicules of unequal length
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指有不規則尖刺的紅血球，問「acanthocyte 還是 echinocyte」並列出病因。
病因：abetalipoproteinemia（MTTP 突變、脂溶性維生素缺乏、脂肪吸收不良）、neuroacanthocytosis（chorea-acanthocytosis VPS13A、McLeod syndrome XK）、嚴重肝病 spur cell anemia、脾切除後。
McLeod phenotype：Kell 抗原表現減弱、缺 Kx 抗原，輸血時會產生抗體而難找到相容血。
Spur cell anemia 見於末期肝硬化，因膜膽固醇增加，提示預後不良。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 echinocyte（burr cell）；echinocyte 有 10–30 個短而規則等距的突起並保留中央淡染，acanthocyte 突起少、長短不一、分布不規則。

quiz.q: 這些緻密、帶不規則長短尖刺的紅血球稱為什麼？請舉一個遺傳性病因。
quiz.a: Acanthocyte；abetalipoproteinemia（或 McLeod syndrome、chorea-acanthocytosis）

3106.recognize_zh: 中型細胞，核有凹陷摺痕、染色質疏鬆呈網狀，周圍有一圈灰藍色胞質，形態雖較小但仍符合單核球。
features: Medium-sized mononuclear cell, slightly smaller than a typical monocyte
Indented, folded nucleus with loose lacy chromatin
No nucleoli
Moderate rim of gray-blue cytoplasm with fine granularity
Occasional platelets nearby
3106.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a medium-sized mononuclear cell with an indented, folded nucleus and loose, lacy chromatin without nucleoli. The cytoplasm forms a moderate gray-blue rim with fine granularity. Findings are consistent with a mature monocyte, a smaller variant with less abundant cytoplasm.

ddx.vs: Lymphocytes have a round nucleus with denser clumped chromatin and clear or deep-blue cytoplasm rather than gray ground-glass cytoplasm.
Buttock cells are smaller with a sharp nuclear cleft, condensed chromatin, and scant cytoplasm.
Myelocytes have a round eccentric nucleus with coarser chromatin and pink-lilac secondary granules.

2978.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞密度高、組織鬆散，可見巨核細胞、紅血球母細胞群與散在細胞質豐富的組織球樣細胞，部分似含紅血球；噬血現象在切片上不易確認，需搭配抹片或 CD163 染色。
features: Hypercellular marrow with loose, edematous architecture
Megakaryocyte and clusters of erythroid precursors with round dark nuclei
Scattered histiocytes with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, some possibly containing red cells
Occasional mitotic figure
Interstitial red cell extravasation
2978.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with a loose, edematous background and interstitial hemorrhage. Megakaryocytes, erythroid precursors and granulocytic cells are present, together with scattered histiocytes with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, some of which appear to contain erythrocytes. Hemophagocytosis is difficult to confirm on H&E sections. Findings may be compatible with hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis in the appropriate context; CD163 immunostain and aspirate review are recommended.

ddx.vs: Reactive marrow lacks increased histiocytes with engulfed cells; CD163 highlights the histiocytic expansion in HLH.

ddx.dx: Marrow involvement by lymphoma (e.g., T-cell lymphoma triggering HLH)
ddx.vs: Lymphoma shows atypical lymphoid aggregates or interstitial atypical cells confirmed by IHC and clonality studies.
MDS shows dysplastic megakaryocytes and abnormal localization of precursors without histiocytic proliferation.

2786.recognize_zh: 這顆顆粒球比一般嗜中性球大，細胞核分成約 8–10 個以上擠在一起的葉（hypersegmentation），細胞質有細小中性顆粒；巨大且過度分葉的嗜中性球屬於顆粒球異常形態，常見於巨母紅血球性貧血、G-CSF 或藥物影響。
features: Enlarged neutrophil (macropolycyte), roughly 1.5-2 times the diameter of adjacent red cells
Markedly hypersegmented nucleus with numerous (well over 6) clustered lobes
Coarse, clumped mature chromatin in each lobe
Cytoplasm with fine neutrophilic granulation, no toxic granulation or Dohle bodies evident
Background red cells show mild anisocytosis without obvious schistocytes
2786.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an enlarged neutrophil with a markedly hypersegmented nucleus composed of numerous clustered lobes of mature, clumped chromatin, and cytoplasm with fine neutrophilic granules. Adjacent red cells show mild anisocytosis. Giant hypersegmented neutrophils (macropolycytes) are a dysplastic-appearing granulocyte change that is most often reactive or nutritional, as seen with vitamin B12/folate deficiency, antimetabolite therapy (e.g., methotrexate, hydroxyurea) or growth factor exposure. Findings are consistent with a dysplastic (hypersegmented, giant) granulocyte; clinical correlation, B12/folate levels and medication history are recommended before attributing it to a myelodysplastic neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic anemia shows the same hypersegmented neutrophils together with macro-ovalocytes and low B12/folate; the neutrophil alone cannot separate it from drug effect.
MDS more typically shows hypogranular or pseudo-Pelger-Huet hyposegmented neutrophils with cytopenias and clonal cytogenetic abnormalities, rather than isolated hypersegmentation.
The hereditary form affects most neutrophils in an otherwise healthy person without macrocytosis, whereas acquired forms occur with nutritional deficiency or drugs.

exam.answer_en: Giant hypersegmented neutrophil (macropolycyte) — enlarged neutrophil with well over six nuclear lobes; consider B12/folate deficiency or drugs before MDS
pearls_zh: 考法：考官問「這顆細胞有幾葉、叫什麼」——hypersegmentation 定義常用 ≥6 葉任一顆，或 5 葉者 ≥5%；體積也增大則稱 macropolycyte。
首要病因：megaloblastic anemia（B12/folate 缺乏）；另見於 antimetabolite（methotrexate、hydroxyurea）、G-CSF、腎衰竭、遺傳性 hereditary hypersegmentation。
Hypersegmented neutrophil 常早於 macrocytic anemia 出現，且補充治療後可持續一段時間；是 megaloblastic 周邊血的敏感線索。
下 MDS dysplasia 前需排除營養與藥物因素；WHO/ICC 的 dysplasia 以某系列 ≥10% 細胞異常為門檻，MDS 較典型的是 hypogranulation 與 pseudo-Pelger 而非 hypersegmentation。
Macropolycyte 有時代表 tetraploid neutrophil，可見於 G-CSF 使用後。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把兩顆重疊的 neutrophil 誤看成一顆多葉細胞；需確認只有單一細胞膜輪廓與連續細胞質，再數葉數。

quiz.q: 見到如圖巨大多葉 neutrophil，首先應檢查哪兩項實驗室數值？
quiz.a: Vitamin B12 與 folate（可加 homocysteine/MMA），並詢問用藥史

2722.recognize_zh: 高倍下這顆淋巴球細胞質豐富、淡藍，核呈腎形凹陷，凹陷處的細胞質中聚集數顆粗大紫紅色嗜天青顆粒——典型大顆粒淋巴球（LGL）。
features: Large lymphocyte about twice a red cell diameter with low-to-moderate N:C ratio
Indented (reniform) nucleus with coarsely condensed chromatin, no nucleoli
Abundant pale blue cytoplasm with slightly irregular outline
Cluster of coarse azurophilic granules in the cytoplasm adjacent to the nuclear indentation
Adjacent platelets and normochromic red cells in background
2722.describe_en: High-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows a large lymphocyte with an indented nucleus, mature coarsely condensed chromatin and no visible nucleoli. The cytoplasm is abundant and pale blue and contains a small cluster of coarse azurophilic granules near the nuclear notch. Surrounding red cells are normochromic and platelets are present. Findings are consistent with a large granular lymphocyte, the morphologic correlate of NK-cell (or T-LGL) lymphocytosis; flow cytometry is required to assign lineage.

ddx.vs: Identical cytology; distinguished only by immunophenotype (surface CD3+, TCR alpha-beta) and clonal TCR rearrangement.
Monocytes have lacy, less condensed chromatin, folded nuclei and gray-blue cytoplasm with fine dust-like granules and vacuoles rather than a few coarse discrete granules.
Reactive lymphocytes have more basophilic cytoplasm that deepens toward the edges and wraps red cells, usually without azurophilic granules.

exam.answer_en: Large granular lymphocyte in NK-cell lymphocytosis — indented mature nucleus with a cluster of coarse azurophilic granules in abundant pale cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指核凹陷處的一小撮紅紫顆粒，問細胞名稱與如何判斷是 NK 還是 T 來源——型態無法區分，需 flow：NK 為 surface CD3−、CD16+、CD56+。
WHO 5th 稱 NK-large granular lymphocytic leukemia（舊稱 chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells），多為惰性、EBV 陰性，可伴 neutropenia 或 anemia。
NK 無 TCR 重排可測克隆性，改以 KIR（CD158）限制性表現、CD94/NKG2A 異常或 STAT3 突變作為克隆替代證據。
必須與 aggressive NK-cell leukemia 鑑別：EBV 陽性、亞洲年輕至中年人較常見、發燒、肝脾腫大、凝血異常與 HLH，病程急性、預後極差。
EBV-positive chronic active EBV disease 與 extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma 周邊血侵犯也在台灣及東亞較常見，需驗 EBV DNA 與 EBER。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 LGL 誤認為 atypical/reactive lymphocyte 或 monocyte；本圖核染色質成熟緻密、細胞質淡且有粗大 azurophilic 顆粒，屬 LGL，但不能單憑型態區分 NK 或 T。

quiz.q: NK-cell LGL 增多無法做 TCR 克隆性檢測，flow 上常用哪類受體的限制性表現作為克隆證據？
quiz.a: KIR（killer immunoglobulin-like receptors，CD158 家族）restriction

2594.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中單一母細胞，核偏位且一側凹陷，染色質細緻，細胞質中等量淡藍色，核旁有淡染區並帶少量淡粉紅顆粒，符合t(8;21) AML常見帶核周空暈的骨髓母細胞；是否有細長Auer小體在此解析度下無法確定。
features: Single blast about twice the size of a red cell
Eccentric nucleus with an indentation on the side facing the cytoplasm
Fine, finely granular chromatin with a faint small nucleolus
Moderate pale-blue cytoplasm with a paler paranuclear zone
Few faint pinkish granules; a delicate Auer rod cannot be confirmed
Thick area of smear with overlapping, stacked red cells
2594.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear, in a thick area with overlapping red cells, shows a single blast with an eccentric, indented nucleus, finely granular chromatin, a faint nucleolus and a moderate amount of pale-blue cytoplasm. A paler paranuclear region containing a few faint pink granules is present adjacent to the nuclear indentation; a slender Auer rod cannot be confidently identified at this resolution. Findings are consistent with a myeloblast of the type seen in AML with t(8;21); confirmation of RUNX1::RUNX1T1 is required.

ddx.vs: Promonocytes have more abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with fine vacuoles and a delicately folded nucleus, and are nonspecific esterase positive rather than strongly MPO positive.
Reactive lymphocytes have more condensed chromatin and cytoplasm that hugs adjacent red cells with peripheral basophilia, without a paranuclear hof containing granules.
Plasma cells show coarse clock-face chromatin and deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm despite the similar perinuclear clearing.

2402.recognize_zh: 高倍下可見早幼粒細胞（核圓、有核仁、顆粒細胞質並有核周淡區）、骨髓細胞、後骨髓細胞到桿狀核嗜中性球一路成熟，細胞形態正常無發育異常，符合恢復中骨髓的顆粒球再生。
features: Promyelocytes with round nuclei, fine chromatin, visible nucleoli and granular basophilic cytoplasm with paranuclear hof
Myelocytes and metamyelocytes with progressively condensed, indented nuclei and pink granular cytoplasm
Numerous band neutrophils with normal granulation
Scattered erythroid precursors and small lymphocytes
Smudged/crushed cells at upper left (smear artifact); no Auer rods or dysplasia evident
2402.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows a spectrum of granulocytic precursors, including promyelocytes with round nuclei, visible nucleoli, and granular cytoplasm with paranuclear hofs, along with myelocytes, metamyelocytes, and numerous band neutrophils. Granulation and nuclear segmentation appear normal, and no Auer rods or dysplastic changes are identified. Occasional erythroid precursors and lymphocytes are present, with smudged cells at the upper left. Findings are consistent with active granulocytic regeneration in a recovering bone marrow.

ddx.vs: APL promyelocytes are atypical with folded nuclei, heavy granules or Auer rod bundles and fail to mature, while here promyelocytes mature normally to bands.
AML with maturation has ≥20% blasts with dysplastic maturing cells, whereas this field shows orderly maturation without increased blasts.
MDS shows hypogranular, hypolobated (pseudo-Pelger) neutrophils and dysplastic erythroids or megakaryocytes, which are absent here.

2018.recognize_zh: 淋巴結中倍 H&E：中央一大片較淡染的區域，細胞質較多、排列較鬆散，推測是竇內單核樣 B 細胞增生（monocytoid B-cell hyperplasia），邊緣另有小團粉紅色類上皮組織球；這是弓漿蟲淋巴結炎三聯徵之一。
features: Lymph node with dense small lymphocytes at the periphery of the field
Central pale zone of cells with more abundant cytoplasm, suggestive of sinusoidal monocytoid B-cell hyperplasia
Small pink clusters of epithelioid histiocytes at the margins of the pale zone
Streaming, sinus-like arrangement of the pale cells
No necrosis or multinucleated giant cells
Cytologic detail of individual cells limited at this magnification
2018.describe_en: H&E section of lymph node at intermediate power shows a central pale zone composed of loosely arranged cells with more abundant cytoplasm in a sinus-like distribution, surrounded by dense small lymphocytes. Small clusters of epithelioid histiocytes are present at the margins. Necrosis and giant cells are absent. At this magnification the pale cells cannot be definitively typed, but the pattern is most suggestive of monocytoid B-cell hyperplasia, consistent with toxoplasma lymphadenitis.

ddx.vs: Marginal zone lymphoma shows confluent sheets of monocytoid cells effacing the architecture with light chain restriction, rather than sinusoidal expansion within a reactive node.
Sinus histiocytosis consists of histiocytes with abundant pink cytoplasm and bland oval nuclei (CD68+), whereas monocytoid B cells have clear cytoplasm and are CD20+.
Cat-scratch disease also has monocytoid B-cell hyperplasia but develops stellate suppurative necrotizing granulomas with neutrophils.

1954.recognize_zh: 淋巴結結構被小至中型淋巴球的密集浸潤取代，中央有一條管壁嗜酸性玻璃樣化的分支血管，血管周圍與左上方聚集胞質淡染/透明的中型細胞，呈現 AITL 的血管周圍透明細胞型態。
features: Diffuse dense infiltrate of small to medium lymphoid cells with irregular hyperchromatic nuclei
Branching vessel with eosinophilic hyalinized wall and plump endothelium crossing the center
Clusters of medium-sized cells with pale to clear cytoplasm, particularly around the vessel and at upper left
Additional thin-walled vessels in the background; follicles not identified
Fibrous tissue at the lower right corner
1954.describe_en: Lymph node section shows diffuse effacement by a dense infiltrate of small to medium lymphoid cells with irregular nuclei. A branching high endothelial venule with a hyalinized eosinophilic wall traverses the field, and clusters of medium-sized cells with pale to clear cytoplasm are present around it and in the upper left. No follicles are identified. Findings are consistent with angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma; TFH markers and CD21 staining are recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: PTCL-NOS lacks perivascular clusters of TFH-phenotype clear cells and expanded perivascular FDC meshworks.
Nodal MZL also has pale monocytoid cells but these are CD20-positive B cells surrounding residual follicles rather than PD-1/CD10-positive T cells.
Reactive paracortex preserves follicles and sinuses and lacks atypical clear cell clusters and T-cell clonality.

1762.recognize_zh: 組織切片中大型多形性腫瘤細胞與大量中性球、少量嗜酸性球混雜，中央可見大型異常核分裂，大細胞核呈不規則或腎形、核仁明顯，符合富含中性球的間變性大細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Diffuse infiltrate of large pleomorphic cells with vesicular, irregular to reniform nuclei and visible nucleoli
Numerous admixed neutrophils with segmented nuclei and scattered eosinophils
Large atypical mitotic figure near the center
Moderate amounts of pale amphophilic cytoplasm
No preserved nodal architecture in this field
1762.describe_en: Tissue section shows a diffuse infiltrate of large pleomorphic cells with irregular to kidney-shaped vesicular nuclei, visible nucleoli, and moderate pale cytoplasm, admixed with abundant neutrophils and scattered eosinophils. An atypical mitotic figure is present. The dense neutrophilic component can obscure the neoplastic cells and suggest an abscess or inflammatory process. Findings are consistent with anaplastic large cell lymphoma, neutrophil-rich pattern; CD30 and ALK immunostains are recommended to highlight the tumor cells.

ddx.dx: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma, mixed cellularity or syncytial variant
ddx.vs: Hodgkin lymphoma contains Reed-Sternberg cells with macronucleoli in a lymphocyte- and eosinophil-rich background and is CD15+, weak PAX5+, and ALK negative.
Reactive inflammation lacks sheets of cytologically atypical large cells and atypical mitoses.
PTCL-NOS shows a range of atypical T cells without uniform strong CD30 and hallmark cells, and is ALK negative.

1698.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中可見兩顆母細胞：核質比高、染色質細緻、細胞質少且偏藍，無顆粒或 Auer 小體；單看型態只能判斷為急性白血病，雙表型（biphenotypic）需靠流式細胞儀確認。
features: Two circulating blasts of medium to large size with high N:C ratio
Round to oval nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin
Scant basophilic cytoplasm without visible granules or Auer rods
One blast smaller and more densely stained than the other
Background red cells with drying-artifact central clearing; image resolution is low
1698.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two circulating blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, fine chromatin and scant basophilic, agranular cytoplasm. Auer rods are not identified. Red cells show refractile drying artifact. The morphology is that of an acute leukemia but is not lineage-specific; the low image resolution also limits assessment of nucleoli. Assignment as mixed-phenotype (biphenotypic) acute leukemia requires flow cytometric demonstration of lineage-defining markers (e.g., MPO plus CD19 with strong CD79a/CD22/CD10).

ddx.vs: Morphology is identical; separation depends on the absence of myeloid-defining markers such as MPO on flow cytometry.
Also agranular without Auer rods; it lacks strong B- or T-lineage-defining markers on immunophenotyping.

ddx.dx: Reactive large granular or activated lymphocyte
ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes have more abundant cytoplasm and condensed chromatin rather than the fine blastic chromatin seen here.

1634.recognize_zh: 淋巴組織中央有一片較淡染的區域，由核較大、染色質較開放、細胞質淡粉紅的中型細胞組成，中間可見一個含兩顆凋亡小體的空暈細胞，周圍被深染小淋巴球包圍，屬正常淋巴組織中的淡染結節（副皮質或生發中心）。
features: Central pale zone of medium-sized cells with round to oval vesicular nuclei and moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Surrounding small lymphocytes with round dense nuclei and scant cytoplasm
A macrophage with a clear halo containing apoptotic nuclear debris near the center
Small vessels with red cells at the periphery
Mixed population without cytologic atypia or sheets of large cells
1634.describe_en: Section of lymphoid tissue at high power shows a pale-staining nodular zone composed of medium-sized cells with vesicular, round to oval nuclei and moderate pale cytoplasm, surrounded by dense small lymphocytes. A macrophage containing apoptotic debris and small vessels are present. The exact compartment (paracortical nodule versus germinal center) cannot be assigned from this single field without immunostains. Findings are consistent with normal/reactive lymphoid tissue.

ddx.vs: Proliferation centers contain prolymphocytes and paraimmunoblasts in a diffusely effaced node of small round lymphocytes, typically without tingible body macrophages.
NLPHL shows large vaguely nodular areas containing large multilobated LP cells, which are not identified here.
Monocytoid B cells cluster in perisinusoidal areas and have more abundant clear cytoplasm and distinct cell borders with admixed neutrophils.

61858.recognize_zh: 中央有一顆明顯大於周圍血小板、接近紅血球大小的顆粒狀紫色物體，中心顆粒集中、邊緣淡而有突起，是大型／巨大血小板（giant platelet）。
features: Central platelet markedly larger than surrounding platelets, approaching the diameter of adjacent red cells
Central concentration of purple granules (granulomere) with a paler, finely fimbriated peripheral hyalomere
Several other scattered platelets, some also enlarged with visible granules
An ovoid pale lilac structure at the top of the field, possibly another large platelet seen en face
Background normocytic red cells with occasional target-like forms; no leukocytes in field
61858.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic red cells with occasional target-like forms and scattered platelets of variable size. In the center is a platelet approaching the size of an adjacent red cell, with centrally clustered purple granules and a pale, irregular peripheral rim. Several other platelets are also larger than normal. No platelet clumps or leukocytes are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with large to giant platelets; correlation with platelet count and clinical context (increased turnover, myeloid neoplasm or inherited macrothrombocytopenia) is needed.

ddx.vs: A lymphocyte has a dense round nucleus with a rim of blue cytoplasm, whereas a platelet is anucleate with granular purple center and pale hyalomere.
Overlap produces a normal-sized platelet superimposed on a red cell in the same focal plane, not a free-standing enlarged platelet.
Megakaryocyte nuclei or nuclear fragments show dense chromatin, which is absent in this anucleate platelet.

exam.answer_en: Giant platelet — granular platelet approaching red-cell size, much larger than surrounding platelets
pearls_zh: 考法：指接近紅血球大小的顆粒狀物問名稱；需說出無核、中央顆粒、邊緣淡藍，以排除淋巴球。
巨大血小板的鑑別：ITP（周邊破壞、MPV 上升）、Bernard-Soulier syndrome（GPIb-IX-V 缺乏，ristocetin 不凝集）、MYH9-related disease、MPN/MDS。
自動分析儀以體積區分血小板與紅血球，巨大血小板可能被算成 RBC，導致血小板假性偏低；需以抹片確認或以 immature platelet fraction 輔助。
MYH9-related disease：巨大血小板加中性球 Döhle-like inclusions，可合併聽力喪失、腎炎與白內障。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為小淋巴球；淋巴球有深染圓核與藍色胞質邊，巨大血小板無核、全為紫色顆粒。

quiz.q: 此結構是什麼？自動計數儀可能會把它算成哪種細胞而造成何種誤差？
quiz.a: Giant platelet；算成 RBC，造成血小板假性偏低

63138.recognize_zh: S-100 在大型組織球的細胞核與豐富細胞質強烈陽性，而箭頭所指的是被包入組織球細胞質中、呈淡色未染的完整淋巴球（細胞穿入現象 emperipolesis），陰性輪廓在棕色背景中特別明顯，這是 Rosai-Dorfman 病的典型表現。
features: Large histiocytes with abundant cytoplasm showing strong nuclear and cytoplasmic S-100 positivity
Intact S-100-negative lymphocytes/inflammatory cells within histiocyte cytoplasm (emperipolesis, arrows)
Histiocyte nuclei round to oval, vesicular, with small nucleoli
Background of fibrous stroma with spindle cells and interspersed small lymphoid cells lacking staining
63138.describe_en: S-100 immunohistochemistry highlights numerous large histiocytes with abundant cytoplasm and strong nuclear and cytoplasmic staining. Within the cytoplasm of several histiocytes, intact unstained lymphocytes are seen (arrows), representing emperipolesis, which is accentuated by the negative outline against the S-100-positive cytoplasm. The background shows fibrous stroma with spindle cells and scattered inflammatory cells. Findings are consistent with extranodal Rosai-Dorfman disease.

ddx.vs: LCH cells are smaller with grooved, reniform nuclei, co-express CD1a and langerin, and lack emperipolesis.
ECD shows foamy histiocytes with Touton giant cells that are usually S-100-negative (or weak), without emperipolesis, and often BRAF V600E-positive.
Reactive histiocytes are S-100-negative and do not show prominent emperipolesis.
IgG4-RD shows storiform fibrosis, obliterative phlebitis and increased IgG4+ plasma cells without S-100-positive emperipolesis-rich histiocytes, although RDD may have increased IgG4 cells.

exam.answer_en: Extranodal Rosai-Dorfman disease — S-100-positive large histiocytes with emperipolesis of intact lymphocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：指箭頭處被包在組織球胞質內的完整淋巴球問 emperipolesis；S-100 讓未染的被吞細胞輪廓更明顯。
RDD 組織球表型：S-100+、CD68+、CD163+、OCT2+；CD1a−、langerin (CD207)−。
淋巴結型典型為兩側頸部無痛大淋巴結、發燒、ESR 上升與多株高 γ 球蛋白；結外以皮膚、鼻腔、骨、中樞神經常見。
部分病例有 MAPK pathway 突變（如 KRAS、MAP2K1），WHO 5th 將 RDD 歸入組織球/樹突細胞腫瘤。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 Langerhans cell histiocytosis（同樣 S-100+）；LCH 細胞核有溝（coffee-bean）、CD1a+/langerin+，且無 emperipolesis。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指的現象稱為什麼？
quiz.a: Emperipolesis（組織球胞質內含完整淋巴球）

62946.recognize_zh: CD20 只標出散在、單個分布的大型非典型細胞（膜狀棕色、核大而空泡狀），周圍大量小淋巴球與組織球皆不染；少數腫瘤性大 B 細胞散布在豐富的非腫瘤背景中，正是富含 T 細胞/組織球大 B 細胞淋巴瘤（THRLBCL）的樣貌。
features: Scattered, individually dispersed large atypical cells with strong membranous CD20 staining
Large cells with vesicular nuclei and moderate cytoplasm, several times the size of background lymphocytes
Abundant background of CD20-negative small lymphocytes and elongated histiocyte/endothelial nuclei
No CD20-positive small B-cell nodules or meshwork in this field
Some granular CD20 debris around positive cells; mitosis not clearly resolvable at this resolution
62946.describe_en: CD20 immunohistochemistry shows scattered, singly dispersed large atypical lymphoid cells with strong membranous staining, set within an abundant CD20-negative background of small lymphocytes and histiocytes. The positive cells have enlarged vesicular nuclei and do not form sheets or cohesive clusters, and no background nodules of small B cells are seen in this field. The findings support B-cell lineage of the large atypical cells and, in the context of a T-cell- and histiocyte-rich background, are consistent with T-cell/histiocyte-rich large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: NLPHL retains at least a focal nodular pattern with a CD20-positive small B-cell meshwork and PD-1+ T-cell rosettes around LP cells, whereas THRLBCL lacks residual small B-cell nodules.
Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are CD30/CD15-positive with weak PAX5 and usually absent or heterogeneous CD20, rather than uniform strong CD20 with CD30 negativity.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma with large B-cell blasts (e.g., angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma)
ddx.vs: AITL has atypical CD3+/PD-1+/CD10+ T cells with expanded CD21 FDC meshworks and often EBV+ B blasts, whereas here the background T cells are non-neoplastic.
Reactive immunoblasts are a mix of B and T cells, lack atypia and occur alongside preserved follicles.

exam.answer_en: T-cell/histiocyte-rich large B-cell lymphoma — CD20 highlights scattered single large atypical B cells in a CD20-negative background
pearls_zh: 考法：問 CD20 標出哪群細胞——只有散在大細胞，背景小淋巴球不染，證明腫瘤為 B 細胞、背景為 T 細胞與組織球。
需加做 CD3（T 細胞背景）、CD68/CD163（組織球），並以 CD21/CD23 與 IgD 排除 NLPHL 殘存結節與 FDC 網。
大細胞 CD30−、CD15−，可與 classic HL 區分；若 EBER 陽性應考慮 EBV+ DLBCL。
臨床常為晚期、肝脾與骨髓侵犯，治療比照 DLBCL（R-CHOP）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤為 NLPHL pattern E；NLPHL 可見殘存 CD20+ 小 B 細胞結節、FDC 網與 PD1+ T 細胞 rosette，THRLBCL 背景缺乏小 B 細胞。

quiz.q: 圖中 CD20 陽性大細胞與陰性背景分別代表什麼？
quiz.a: 腫瘤性大 B 細胞；反應性 T 細胞與組織球

62434.recognize_zh: 大片中等大小、單調一致、核圓且可見小核仁的腫瘤細胞，BCL2 完全不染，只有少數散在的小型反應性 T 細胞呈棕色膜狀／細胞質陽性當作內部對照；BCL2 陰性支持 Burkitt 淋巴瘤，而非 BCL2 陽性的高惡性度 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Diffuse sheets of monotonous intermediate-sized lymphoid cells with round nuclei and small nucleoli
Neoplastic cells negative for BCL2
Rare scattered small positive cells (reactive T cells) providing an internal positive control
Cohesive-appearing sheet with squared-off cell borders; tingible-body macrophages not clearly highlighted
62434.describe_en: BCL2 immunohistochemistry shows diffuse sheets of monotonous intermediate-sized lymphoid cells with round nuclei and small nucleoli that are entirely negative for BCL2. Rare scattered small reactive lymphocytes show cytoplasmic staining and serve as an internal positive control. Absence of BCL2 in the neoplastic cells, together with a CD10+, BCL6+ phenotype, Ki-67 near 100% and MYC rearrangement, supports Burkitt lymphoma. Findings are consistent with Burkitt lymphoma.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: Double-hit lymphoma usually shows strong BCL2 expression and requires FISH for BCL2 rearrangement, while Burkitt lymphoma is BCL2-negative or only weak.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, germinal center type
ddx.vs: DLBCL has larger, more pleomorphic cells, often BCL2-positive, with Ki-67 generally below 90%.
Lymphoblasts have finer chromatin, are TdT/CD34-positive and surface immunoglobulin-negative, and lack MYC::IG rearrangement.
Blastoid MCL is CD5-positive, BCL2-positive and cyclin D1/SOX11-positive.

exam.answer_en: Burkitt lymphoma — monotonous intermediate-sized cells negative for BCL2, with scattered reactive T cells as internal positive control
pearls_zh: 考法：判讀 BCL2 先確認散在小型反應性 T 細胞有染（內部對照），腫瘤細胞陰性才有意義。
Burkitt 表型：CD20+、CD10+、BCL6+、BCL2 陰性或極弱、TdT−、Ki-67 近 100%；MYC 重組以 t(8;14) 最常見。
若同時有 MYC 與 BCL2 重組，WHO 5th 歸為 DLBCL/HGBL with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements，而非 Burkitt。
急症：腫瘤溶解症候群（高尿酸、高鉀、高磷），治療前需水化並給 rasburicase 等預防。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易以 BCL2 IHC 陰性直接排除 double-hit；少數 BCL2 重組因抗原表位突變使常用抗體假陰性，仍需 FISH 檢測 MYC、BCL2、BCL6。

quiz.q: BCL2 染色中陽性的小細胞扮演什麼角色？腫瘤細胞結果支持何診斷？
quiz.a: 反應性 T 細胞（內部陽性對照）；腫瘤 BCL2 陰性支持 Burkitt lymphoma

64994.recognize_zh: 腎臟切片中度倍率下，腎實質幾乎被瀰漫的小淋巴樣細胞浸潤取代，只剩散在的血管，看不到明確的腎小管或腎絲球；此視野未見明顯濾泡結構，濾泡性淋巴瘤的診斷需靠免疫染色佐證。
features: Diffuse, dense infiltrate of small lymphoid cells effacing renal parenchyma
Small cells with round to slightly irregular dark nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Residual thick-walled vessels, including a larger congested vessel at the top
No clearly recognizable tubules or glomeruli in this field
No well-formed follicular (nodular) pattern discernible at this magnification
Pale, faded staining limits cytologic detail
64994.describe_en: H&E-stained renal biopsy at intermediate power shows effacement of the renal parenchyma by a dense, diffuse infiltrate of small lymphoid cells with scant cytoplasm, with only residual interspersed blood vessels and no clearly preserved tubules or glomeruli. A follicular growth pattern is not evident in this field, and image quality limits assessment of centrocytes versus centroblasts. The infiltrate is monotonous without a prominent mixed inflammatory component. Findings are consistent with renal involvement by a low-grade B-cell lymphoma; immunohistochemistry (CD20, CD10, BCL6, BCL2) is needed to support follicular lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Interstitial nephritis contains a mixed infiltrate with plasma cells, eosinophils, and tubulitis while preserving tubules, rather than monotonous effacement.
CLL/SLL shows proliferation centers and is CD5+/CD23+, whereas follicular lymphoma is CD10+/BCL6+ with BCL2 and t(14;18).
MZL cells often have more pale cytoplasm with plasmacytic differentiation and are CD10- and BCL6-.
PTLD occurs in transplant recipients, is often polymorphous with plasma cells and immunoblasts, and is frequently EBER positive.

60706.recognize_zh: 腦脊髓液抹片（cytospin）中可見偏心核、核周淡染區（hof）及嗜鹼性細胞質的漿細胞，部分為雙核並帶核內淡染包涵體（箭頭）；下方 B–F 依序呈現前期、中期（極面觀與側面觀）、後期到末期的有絲分裂，表示腦脊髓液中的骨髓瘤細胞仍在增殖。
features: Panel A: CSF cytospin with a cluster of plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, coarse chromatin and paranuclear hof
Abundant basophilic cytoplasm with ruffled borders; binucleate cells with pale intranuclear inclusions (arrows)
Panels B–F: plasma cells in successive mitotic stages (prophase/prometaphase, metaphase in polar and side view, anaphase, telophase)
Atypical features including nucleoli and multinucleation support neoplastic rather than reactive plasma cells
Clean background without significant inflammatory cells or red cells
60706.describe_en: Cytospin preparation of cerebrospinal fluid shows numerous plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, clumped chromatin, paranuclear clearing, and abundant basophilic cytoplasm with ruffled borders (A). Atypical forms include binucleate cells and nuclei with pale intranuclear inclusions (arrows). Panels B through F display plasma cells in sequential stages of mitosis, from prophase/prometaphase through metaphase, anaphase, and telophase, indicating active proliferation. Findings are consistent with central nervous system involvement by plasma cell myeloma; confirmation of clonality by flow cytometry or light-chain restriction is recommended.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are few, cytologically bland, polytypic, and accompanied by lymphocytes, whereas myelomatous involvement shows atypical, mitotically active, light-chain–restricted plasma cells.

ddx.dx: Lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation (e.g., lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma, Bing-Neel syndrome)
ddx.vs: LPL/Bing-Neel shows a mixed population of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes, and plasma cells with MYD88 L265P rather than a pure atypical plasma cell population.
Plasmablastic lymphoma has large immunoblastic cells with prominent central nucleoli, is often EBER-positive and HIV-associated, and lacks a history of myeloma.
